export function createAsyncMemo<K, V>(fn: (key: K) => Promise<V>): (key: K) => Promise<V> {
  const cache = new Map<K, Promise<V>>();
  return (key: K): Promise<V> => {
    const existing = cache.get(key);
    if (existing !== undefined) return existing;
    const p = fn(key);
    cache.set(key, p);

```typescript
function tokenize(input: string): Token[] {
  const tokens: Token[] = [];
  let i = 0;
  while (i < input.length) {
    const char = input[i];
    if (char === ' ' || char === '\t' || char === '\n' || char === '\r') {
      i++;
      continue;
    }
    if (char >= '0' && char <= '9') {
      let numStr = '';
      while (i < input.length && input[i] >= '0' && input[i] <= '9') {
        numStr += input[i];
        i++;
      }
      tokens.push({ type: 'NUM', value: parseInt(numStr, 10) });
      continue;
    }
    switch (char) {
      case '+': tokens.push({ type: 'PLUS' }); break;
      case '-': tokens.push({ type: 'MINUS' }); break;
      case '*': tokens.push({ type: 'MULT' }); break;
      case '/': tokens.push({ type: 'DIV' }); break;
      case '(': tokens.push({ type: 'LPAREN' }); break;
      case ')': tokens.push({ type: 'RPAREN' }); break;
      default: throw new Error(`Unexpected character: ${char}`);
    }
    i++;
  }
  tokens.push({ type: 'EOF' });
  return tokens;
}
```

```typescript
class Parser {
  private pos = 0;
  private tokens: Token[];
  private error: string | null = null;
```

```typescript
  constructor(tokens: Token[]) { this.tokens = tokens; }

  private peek(): Token { return this.tokens[this.pos] ?? { type: 'EOF' }; }

      if (op !== '+' && op !== '-') break;

      if (this.error !== null) return 0;
      left = op === '+' ? left + right : left - right;

    return left;
  }

  private parseTerm(): number {

    if (this.error !== null) return 0;
    while (this.peek().type === 'OP') {
      const op = this.peek().value;
      if (op !== '*' && op !== '/') break;
      this.pos++;

      if (this.error !== null) return 0;
      if (op === '/' && right === 0) { this.error = 'Division by zero'; return 0; }

  private parseFactor(): number {

      if (!this.consume('RPAREN')) return 0;

      if (this.error !== null) return 0;
      return tok.value === '-' ? -val : val;
    }
    if (tok.type === 'NUM') { this.pos++; return tok.value; }
```

  | { readonly ok: false; readonly error: string };

```typescript
    ctx.pos++;
  }
}

function peek(ctx: ParseContext): string | undefined {
  skipWhitespace(ctx);
  return ctx.input[ctx.pos];
}

function consume(ctx: ParseContext, expected: string): void {
  skipWhitespace(ctx);
  if (ctx.input[ctx.pos] !== expected) {
    throw new Error(`Expected '${expected}'`);
  }
  ctx.pos++;
}

function parseNumber(ctx: ParseContext): number {
  skipWhitespace(ctx);
  const start = ctx.pos;
  while (ctx.pos < ctx.input.length && /\d/.test(ctx.input[ctx.pos])) {

  }
  return parseInt(ctx.input.slice(start, ctx.pos), 10);
}

  if (ch === '(') {

    const val = parseExpr(ctx);
    consume(ctx, ')');
    return val;
  }
  return parseNumber(ctx);
}

  let val = parseFactor(ctx);

      val *= parseFactor(ctx);
```

```typescript
  readonly value: V;
  readonly expiresAt: number;
}

export interface LruCache<K, V> {
  get(key: K): V | undefined;
  set(key: K, value: V): void;
  has(key: K): boolean;
  readonly size: number;
}

function isLive<V>(entry: Entry<V>, now: number): boolean {
  return now < entry.expiresAt;
}

function evictOldest<K, V>(map: Map<K, Entry<V>>, capacity: number): void {
  while (map.size >= capacity) {
```
```typescript
    const key = map.keys().next().value;
    if (key === undefined) break;
    map.delete(key);
  }
}

export function createLruCache<K, V>(
  capacity: number,
  ttlMs: number,
  clock: Clock
): LruCache<K, V> {
  const store = new Map<K, Entry<V>>();

  const get = (key: K): V | undefined => {
    const entry = store.get(key);
    if (!entry) return undefined;
    const now = clock.now();
    if (!isLive(entry, now)) {
      store.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }
    store.delete(key);
    store.set(key, { value: entry.value, expiresAt: now + ttlMs });
    return entry.value;
  };

  const set = (key: K, value: V): void => {
    store.delete(key);
    evictOldest(store, capacity);
    store.set(key, { value, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
  };

  const has = (key: K): boolean => {
    const entry = store.get(key);
    if (!entry) return false;
    const now = clock.now();
    if (!isLive(entry, now)) {
      store.delete(key);
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  };

  return {
    get,
    set,
    has,
    get size(): number {
      const now = clock.now();
      let count = 0;
      for (const entry of store.values()) {
        if (isLive(entry, now)) count++;
      }
      return count;
    }
  };
}
```

```typescript
interface BucketState {
  readonly tokens: number;
  readonly lastRefillAt: number;
}

export interface RateLimiter {
  tryAcquire(key: string, tokens?: number): boolean;
}

  tokens: capacity,
  lastRefillAt: now,
});

  bucket: BucketState,
  capacity: number,
  refillPerSec: number,
  now: number
): BucketState => {

  if (elapsed <= 0) return bucket;

  const added = elapsed * refillPerSec;
  const newTokens = Math.min(capacity, bucket.tokens + added);
  return { tokens: newTokens, lastRefillAt: now };
};

  capacity: number,
  refillPerSec: number,
  clock: Clock
): RateLimiter {

  };
}
```

```typescript
function isExpired(entry: CacheEntry<unknown>, now: number): boolean {
  return now >= entry.expiresAt;
}

function evictLeastRecent(entries: Map<string, CacheEntry<unknown>>, now: number): void {
```
```typescript
  let targetKey: string | undefined;
  let minRecency = Infinity;

  for (const [key, entry] of entries) {
    const recency = isExpired(entry, now) ? Infinity : entry.recency;
    if (recency < minRecency) {
      minRecency = recency;
      targetKey = key;
    }
  }
```

}

export interface LruCache<K, V> {
  get(key: K): V | undefined;
  set(key: K, value: V): void;
  has(key: K): boolean;
  readonly size: number;
}

export function createLruCache<K, V>(
  capacity: number,
  ttlMs: number,
  clock: Clock
): LruCache<K, V> {
  const entries = new Map<string, CacheEntry<V>>();
  let recencyCounter = 0;

  const now = (): number => clock.now();
  const touchRecency = (): number => ++recencyCounter;

  const purgeExpired = (nowVal: number): void => {
    for (const [k, e] of entries) if (isExpired(e, nowVal)) entries.delete(k);
  };

  const handleEviction = (nowVal: number): void => {
    if (entries.size < capacity) return;
    purgeExpired(nowVal);
    if (entries.size < capacity) return;
    evictLeastRecent(entries, nowVal);
  };

  const getEntry = (key: string): CacheEntry<V> | undefined => entries.get(key);

  return {
    get(key: K): V | undefined {
      const entry = getEntry(String(key));
      if (!entry || isExpired(entry, now())) {
        if (entry) entries.delete(String(key));
        return undefined;
      }
      entry.recency = touchRecency();
      return entry.value;
    },

    set(key: K, value: V): void {
      const strKey = String(key);
      const currentNow = now();

      if (entries.has(strKey)) {
        entries.set(strKey, { value, expiresAt: currentNow + ttlMs, recency: touchRecency() });
        return;
      }

      handleEviction(currentNow);
      entries.set(strKey, { value, expiresAt: currentNow + ttlMs, recency: touchRecency() });
    },

    has(key: K): boolean {
      const entry = getEntry(String(key));
      return !!entry && !isExpired(entry, now());
    },

    get size(): number {
      const currentNow = now();
      let count = 0;
      for (const entry of entries.values()) {
        if (!isExpired(entry, currentNow)) count++;
      }
      return count;
    }
  };
}

import { Clock } from '../../lib/clock';

interface CacheEntry<V> {
  value: V;
  expiresAt: number;
  recency: number;
}

export interface LruCache<K, V> {
  get(key: K): V | undefined;
  set(key: K, value: V): void;
  has(key: K): boolean;
  readonly size: number;
}

export function createLruCache<K, V>(
  capacity: number,
  ttlMs: number,
  clock: Clock
): LruCache<K, V> {
  const entries = new Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>();
  let recencyCounter = 0;

  const isExpired = (entry: CacheEntry<V>): boolean =>
    clock.now() >= entry.expiresAt;

  const removeExpired = (): void => {
    for (const key of entries.keys()) {
      const entry = entries.get(key);
      if (entry && isExpired(entry)) {
        entries.delete(key);
      }
    }
  };

  const evictLeastRecent = (): void => {
    let oldestKey: K | undefined;
    let oldestRecency = Infinity;
    for (const [key, entry] of entries) {
      if (!isExpired(entry) && entry.recency < oldestRecency) {
        oldestRecency = entry.recency;
        oldestKey = key;
      }
    }
    if (oldestKey !== undefined) {
      entries.delete(oldestKey);
    }
  };

  const bumpRecency = (): number => ++recencyCounter;

  return {
    get(key: K): V | undefined {
      removeExpired();
      const entry = entries.get(key);
      if (!entry) return undefined;
      entry.recency = bumpRecency();
      return entry.value;
    },

    set(key: K, value: V): void {
      removeExpired();
      if (entries.size >= capacity) {
        evictLeastRecent();
      }
      entries.set(key, {
        value,
        expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs,
        recency: bumpRecency(),
      });
    },

    has(key: K): boolean {
      removeExpired();
      return entries.has(key);
    },

    get size(): number {
      removeExpired();
      return entries.size;
    },
  };
}

```typescript
import type { Clock } from '../../lib/clock';

interface CacheNode<V> {
  readonly value: V;
  readonly expiresAt: number;
  lastAccessed: number;
}

export interface LruCache<K, V> {
  get(key: K): V | undefined;
  set(key: K, value: V): void;
  has(key: K): boolean;
  readonly size: number;
}

function isExpired(node: CacheNode<unknown>, now: number): boolean {
  return now >= node.expiresAt;
}

function touchNode(node: CacheNode<unknown>, now: number): void {
  node.lastAccessed = now;
}

function evictOldest<K, V>(store: Map<K, CacheNode<V>>, capacity: number, now: number): void {
  const entries = Array.from(store.entries());
  const expiredKeys = entries.filter(([, node]) => isExpired(node, now)).map(([key]) => key);
  expiredKeys.forEach(k => store.delete(k));

  while (store.size > capacity) {
    let oldestKey: K | undefined;
    let oldestAccessed = Infinity;
    for (const [key, node] of store) {
      if (node.lastAccessed < oldestAccessed) {
        oldestAccessed = node.lastAccessed;
        oldestKey = key;
      }
    }
    if (oldestKey === undefined) break;
    store.delete(oldestKey);
  }
}

function cacheGet<K, V>(store: Map<K, CacheNode<V>>, clock: Clock, key: K): V | undefined {
  const now = clock.now();
  const node = store.get(key);
  if (node === undefined || isExpired(node, now)) {
    store.delete(key);
    return undefined;
  }
  touchNode(node, now);
  return node.value;
}

function cacheHas<K, V>(store: Map<K, CacheNode<V>>, clock: Clock, key: K): boolean {
  const now = clock.now();
  const node = store.get(key);
  if (node === undefined || isExpired(node, now)) {
    store.delete(key);
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

function cacheSize<K, V>(store: Map<K, CacheNode<V>>, clock: Clock): number {
  const now = clock.now();
  for (const [key, node] of store) {
    if (isExpired(node, now)) {
      store.delete(key);
    }
  }
  return store.size;
}

function cacheSet<K, V>(store: Map<K, CacheNode<V>>, clock: Clock, capacity: number, ttlMs: number, key: K, value: V): void {
  const now = clock.now();
  if (store.has(key)) {
    store.delete(key);
  }
  evictOldest(store, capacity, now);
  store.set(key, { value, expiresAt: now + ttlMs, lastAccessed: now });
}

export function createLruCache<K, V>(capacity: number, ttlMs: number, clock: Clock): LruCache<K, V> {
  const store = new Map<K, CacheNode<V>>();
  return {
    get(key: K): V | undefined { return cacheGet(store, clock, key); },
    has(key: K): boolean { return cacheHas(store, clock, key); },
    get size(): number { return cacheSize(store, clock); },
    set(key: K, value: V): void { cacheSet(store, clock, capacity, ttlMs, key, value); },
  };
}
```

```typescript
import type { Clock } from '../../lib/clock';

interface CacheNode<V> {
  readonly value: V;
  readonly expiresAt: number;
  lastAccessed: number;
}

export interface LruCache<K, V> {
  get(key: K): V | undefined;
  set(key: K, value: V): void;
  has(key: K): boolean;
  readonly size: number;
}

function isExpired(node: CacheNode<unknown>, now: number): boolean {
  return now >= node.expiresAt;
}

function touchNode(node: CacheNode<unknown>, now: number): void {
  node.lastAccessed = now;
}

function evictOldest<K, V>(store: Map<K, CacheNode<V>>, capacity: number, now: number): void {
  const entries = Array.from(store.entries());
  const expiredKeys = entries.filter(([, node]) => isExpired(node, now)).map(([key]) => key);
  expiredKeys.forEach(k => store.delete(k));

  while (store.size > capacity) {
    let oldestKey: K | undefined;
    let oldestAccessed = Infinity;
    for (const [key, node] of store) {
      if (node.lastAccessed < oldestAccessed) {
        oldestAccessed = node.lastAccessed;
        oldestKey = key;
      }
    }
    if (oldestKey === undefined) break;
    store.delete(oldestKey);
  }
}

function cacheGet<K, V>(store: Map<K, CacheNode<V>>, clock: Clock, key: K): V | undefined {
  const now = clock.now();
  const node = store.get(key);
  if (node === undefined || isExpired(node, now)) {
    store.delete(key);
    return undefined;
  }
  touchNode(node, now);
  return node.value;
}

function cacheHas<K, V>(store: Map<K, CacheNode<V>>, clock: Clock, key: K): boolean {
  const now = clock.now();
  const node = store.get(key);
  if (node === undefined || isExpired(node, now)) {
    store.delete(key);
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

function cacheSize<K, V>(store: Map<K, CacheNode<V>>, clock: Clock): number {
  const now = clock.now();
  const expiredKeys = Array.from(store.entries())
    .filter(([, node]) => isExpired(node, now))
    .map(([key]) => key);
  expiredKeys.forEach(k => store.delete(k));
  return store.size;
}

function cacheSet<K, V>(store: Map<K, CacheNode<V>>, clock: Clock, capacity: number, ttlMs: number, key: K, value: V): void {
  const now = clock.now();
  if (store.has(key)) {
    store.delete(key);
  }
  evictOldest(store, capacity, now);
  store.set(key, { value, expiresAt: now + ttlMs, lastAccessed: now });

    get size(): number { return cacheSize(store, clock); },
```

```ts
export const PERCENT_BASE = 100;

function pctOf(amount: Amount): number {
  return amount.kind === "percent" ? amount.pct : 0;
}

async function adjustmentOf(base: number, amount: Amount): Promise<number> {
  if (amount.kind === "fixed") {
    return amount.value;

  if (amount.kind === "deferred") {
    return amount.load();

}

  const totals = await Promise.all(items.map(item => lineTotal(item)));
  return totals.reduce((sum: number, total: number): number => sum + total, 0);
}
```

```ts
export interface PriceCache {
  get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number>;
}

interface CacheEntry {
  readonly value: number;
  readonly expiresAt: number;
}

interface PendingEntry {
  readonly promise: Promise<number>;
}

const DEFAULT_TTL_MS = 60_000;

function isPendingEntry(entry: CacheEntry | PendingEntry): entry is PendingEntry {
  return "promise" in entry;
}

export function createPriceCache(clock: Clock, ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS): PriceCache {
  const store = new Map<string, CacheEntry | PendingEntry>();
  return {
    async get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number> {
      const existing = store.get(key);
      if (existing !== undefined) {
        if (isPendingEntry(existing)) {
          return existing.promise;
        }
        if (existing.expiresAt > clock.now()) {
          return existing.value;
        }
      }

      const promise = compute().then(
        (value) => {
          store.set(key, { value, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
          return value;
        },
        (error) => {
          store.delete(key);
          throw error;
        }
      );
      store.set(key, { promise });
      return promise;
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
  readonly value: number;
  readonly expiresAt: number;

      return promise;
    },
  };
```

import type { Clock } from "../../lib/clock";

export interface PriceCache {
  /** Return the cached total for `key` if fresh, else run `compute` and cache its result. */
  get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number>;
}

```ts
interface FreshEntry { readonly value: number; readonly expiresAt: number; }
interface PendingEntry { readonly promise: Promise<number>; }
type Entry = FreshEntry | PendingEntry;
```

```ts
const DEFAULT_TTL_MS = 60_000;

export function createPriceCache(clock: Clock, ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS): PriceCache {
  const entries = new Map<string, Entry>();
  return {
    async get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number> {
      const entry = entries.get(key);
      if (entry !== undefined && "value" in entry && entry.expiresAt > clock.now()) {
        return entry.value;
      }
      if (entry !== undefined && "promise" in entry) {
        return entry.promise;
      }
      const promise = compute()
        .then(value => {
          entries.set(key, { value, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
          return value;
        })
        .catch(err => {
          entries.delete(key);
          throw err;
        });
      entries.set(key, { promise });
      return promise;
    },
  };
}
```

import type { Clock } from "../../lib/clock";

export interface PriceCache {
  /** Return the cached total for `key` if fresh, else run `compute` and cache its result. */
  get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number>;
}

interface CacheEntry {
  readonly value: number;
  readonly expiresAt: number;
}

interface InFlightEntry {
  readonly promise: Promise<number>;
}

const DEFAULT_TTL_MS = 60_000;

export function createPriceCache(clock: Clock, ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS): PriceCache {
  const entries = new Map<string, CacheEntry>();
  const inFlight = new Map<string, InFlightEntry>();

  const resolve = (key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number> => {
    const existing = inFlight.get(key);
    if (existing !== undefined) {
      return existing.promise;
    }

    const promise = compute().then((value) => {
      inFlight.delete(key);
      entries.set(key, { value, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
      return value;
    });

    inFlight.set(key, { promise });
    return promise;
  };

  return {
    async get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number> {
      const hit = entries.get(key);
      if (hit !== undefined && hit.expiresAt > clock.now()) {
        return hit.value;
      }
      return resolve(key, compute);
    },
  };
}

```ts
import type { Clock } from "../../lib/clock";

export interface PriceCache {
  get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number>;
}

interface CacheEntry {
  readonly value: number;
  readonly expiresAt: number;
}

const DEFAULT_TTL_MS = 60_000;

export function createPriceCache(clock: Clock, ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS): PriceCache {
  const entries = new Map<string, CacheEntry>();
  const pending = new Map<string, Promise<number>>();

  return {
    async get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number> {
      const hit = entries.get(key);
      if (hit !== undefined && hit.expiresAt > clock.now()) {
        return hit.value;
      }

      const existingPromise = pending.get(key);
      if (existingPromise !== undefined) {
        return existingPromise;
      }

      const promise = compute()
        .then((value: number) => {
          entries.set(key, { value, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
          return value;
        })
        .catch((error: unknown) => {
          pending.delete(key);
          throw error;
        })
        .finally(() => {
          pending.delete(key);
        });

      pending.set(key, promise);
      return promise;
    },
  };
}
```
Wait, `pending.delete(key)` in `finally` ensures that if it fails, the next `get` will create a new promise. If it succeeds, it's also deleted from `pending`, but already cached in `entries`. This satisfies:
- concurrent `get` calls share ONE computation
- failed computation is never cached
- entries expire after TTL
- different keys stay independent

"concurrent get calls for the same fresh key share ONE computation (compute — and therefore a deferred load() — is invoked exactly once)" -> `pending` map handles this.

"entries still expire after the TTL via the injected Clock" -> `expiresAt > clock.now()` check handles this.
"different keys stay independent" -> `Map` keys are independent.

import type { Amount, LineItem } from "./types";

export const PERCENT_BASE = 100;

function pctOf(amount: Amount): number {
  return amount.kind === "percent" ? amount.pct : 0;
}

function syncAdjustmentOf(base: number, amount: Amount): number {
  if (amount.kind === "fixed") {
    return amount.value;
  }
  return (base * pctOf(amount)) / PERCENT_BASE;
}

export async function lineTotal(item: LineItem): Promise<number> {
  const adj =
    item.adjustment.kind === "deferred"
      ? await item.adjustment.load()
      : syncAdjustmentOf(item.base, item.adjustment);
  return item.base + adj;
}

export async function computeTotal(items: readonly LineItem[]): Promise<number> {
  let sum = 0;
  for (const item of items) {
    sum += await lineTotal(item);
  }
  return sum;
}

```typescript
  return state.tokens[state.pos];

    }
```
```typescript
    if (c === '(') { toks.push({ t: 'L' }); i++; continue; }
    if (c === ')') { toks.push({ t: 'R' }); i++; continue; }
    throw new Error(`Unexpected character: ${c}`);
  }
  return toks;
}
```

```typescript
    const right = parseTerm(state);
    if (!right.ok) return right;
    left = { ok: true, value: op === '+' ? left.value + right.value : left.value - right.value };

  if (!left.ok) return left;

    const right = parseFactor(state);

    left = { ok: true, value: op === '*' ? left.value * right.value : left.value / right.value };
  }
  return left;
}

  const tok = peek(state);
  if (tok?.t === 'N') { consume(state); return { ok: true, value: tok.v }; }
  if (tok?.t === 'L') {

    const expr = parseExpr(state);
    if (!expr.ok) return expr;
    if (peek(state)?.t !== 'R') return { ok: false, error: 'Missing closing parenthesis' };
    consume(state);
    return expr;

  if (tok?.t === 'O' && (tok.v === '+' || tok.v === '-')) {
    consume(state);
    const factor = parseFactor(state);
    if (!factor.ok) return factor;
    return { ok: true, value: tok.v === '+' ? factor.value : -factor.value };
  }

    const state: ParserState = { tokens: toks, pos: 0 };
    const result = parseExpr(state);
    if (!result.ok) return result;
    if (state.pos < toks.length) return { ok: false, error: 'Unexpected trailing tokens' };
    return result;
  } catch (err) {
```

```typescript
interface CacheEntry {
  readonly value: number;
  readonly expiresAt: number;
}

interface PendingEntry {
  readonly promise: Promise<number>;

export function createPriceCache(clock: Clock, ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS): PriceCache {
  const entries = new Map<string, CacheEntry>();
  const pending = new Map<string, PendingEntry>();

  return {
    async get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number> {
      const hit = entries.get(key);
      if (hit !== undefined && hit.expiresAt > clock.now()) {
        return hit.value;
      }

      const pendingEntry = pending.get(key);
      if (pendingEntry !== undefined) {
        return pendingEntry.promise;
      }

      const promise = compute().then(value => {
        entries.set(key, { value, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
        pending.delete(key);
        return value;
      }).catch(err => {
        pending.delete(key);
        throw err;
      });

      pending.set(key, { promise });
      return promise;
    },
  };
```

```typescript
import type { Clock } from "../../lib/clock";

export interface PriceCache {
  /** Return the cached total for `key` if fresh, else run `compute` and cache its result. */
  get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number>;
}

interface CacheEntry {
  readonly value: number;
  readonly expiresAt: number;
}
```

```ts
interface InFlightEntry {
  readonly promise: Promise<number>;
}

const DEFAULT_TTL_MS = 60_000;

export function createPriceCache(clock: Clock, ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS): PriceCache {
```
```ts
  const store = new Map<string, CacheEntry | InFlightEntry>();

  return {
    async get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number> {
      const entry = store.get(key);
      if (entry && "value" in entry && entry.expiresAt > clock.now()) return entry.value;
```
```ts
      if (entry && "promise" in entry) return entry.promise;

      const promise = compute().then((value: number) => {
        store.set(key, { value, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
        return value;
      }).catch((err: unknown) => {
        store.delete(key);
        throw err;
      });

      store.set(key, { promise });
      return promise;
    },
  };
}
```

import type { Clock } from '../../lib/clock';

interface CacheEntry<V> {
  readonly value: V;
  readonly insertedAt: number;
  lastAccessedAt: number;
}

function isExpired(entry: CacheEntry<unknown>, now: number, ttlMs: number): boolean {
  return now >= entry.insertedAt + ttlMs;
}

function removeEntry<K, V>(map: Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>, key: K): void {
  map.delete(key);
}

function refreshRecency<K, V>(map: Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>, key: K, now: number): void {
  const entry = map.get(key);
  if (entry !== undefined) {
    entry.lastAccessedAt = now;
  }
}

function evictLru<K, V>(
  map: Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>,
  capacity: number,
  now: number,
  ttlMs: number
): void {
  if (map.size <= capacity) {
    return;
  }
  let lruKey: K | undefined;
  let lruTime = Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
  for (const [key, entry] of map) {
    if (isExpired(entry, now, ttlMs)) {
      removeEntry(map, key);
      return;
    }
    if (entry.lastAccessedAt < lruTime) {
      lruTime = entry.lastAccessedAt;
      lruKey = key;
    }
  }
  if (lruKey !== undefined) {
    removeEntry(map, lruKey);
  }
}

function countLive<K, V>(
  map: Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>,
  now: number,
  ttlMs: number
): number {
  let count = 0;
  for (const entry of map.values()) {
    if (!isExpired(entry, now, ttlMs)) {
      count++;
    }
  }
  return count;
}

export interface LruCache<K, V> {
  get(key: K): V | undefined;
  set(key: K, value: V): void;
  has(key: K): boolean;
  readonly size: number;
}

export function createLruCache<K, V>(
  capacity: number,
  ttlMs: number,
  clock: Clock
): LruCache<K, V> {
  const map = new Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>();

  return {
    get(key: K): V | undefined {
      const now = clock.now();
      const entry = map.get(key);
      if (entry === undefined || isExpired(entry, now, ttlMs)) {
        if (entry !== undefined) {
          removeEntry(map, key);
        }
        return undefined;
      }
      refreshRecency(map, key, now);
      return entry.value;
    },

    set(key: K, value: V): void {
      const now = clock.now();
      evictLru(map, capacity, now, ttlMs);
      map.set(key, { value, insertedAt: now, lastAccessedAt: now });
    },

    has(key: K): boolean {
      const now = clock.now();
      const entry = map.get(key);
      if (entry === undefined) {
        return false;
      }
      if (isExpired(entry, now, ttlMs)) {
        removeEntry(map, key);
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    },

    get size(): number {
      return countLive(map, clock.now(), ttlMs);
    },
  };
}

```typescript
interface CacheEntry<V> {
```
```typescript
  readonly value: V;
```
```typescript
  readonly insertedAt: number;
```

```typescript
export interface LruCache<K, V> {
  get(key: K): V | undefined;
  set(key: K, value: V): void;
  has(key: K): boolean;
  readonly size: number;
```

```typescript
function isExpired(entry: CacheEntry<unknown>, now: number, ttlMs: number): boolean {
  return now >= entry.insertedAt + ttlMs;
}

function evictOldest<K, V>(map: Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>): void {
  const firstKey = map.keys().next().value;
  if (firstKey !== undefined) {
    map.delete(firstKey);
  }
}

function pruneExpired<K, V>(map: Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>, now: number, ttlMs: number): void {
  for (const [key, entry] of map.entries()) {
    if (isExpired(entry, now, ttlMs)) {
      map.delete(key);
    }
  }
}

function refreshOrder<K, V>(map: Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>, key: K): void {
  const entry = map.get(key);
  if (entry !== undefined) {
    map.delete(key);
    map.set(key, entry);
  }
}

  capacity: number,
  ttlMs: number,
```

```typescript
const makeParser = (tks: readonly Token[]) => {
  let pos = 0;
  const peek = () => tks[pos];
  const advance = () => tks[pos++];
  const expect = (type: string) => {
    const t = peek();
    if (t.type !== type) throw new Error(`Expected ${type}, got ${t.type}`);
    return advance();
  };
  return { peek, advance, expect };
};
```

```typescript
interface OpToken { readonly type: 'PLUS' | 'MINUS' | 'MUL' | 'DIV'; }
interface ParenToken { readonly type: 'LPAREN' | 'RPAREN'; }
interface EofToken { readonly type: 'EOF'; }
type Token = NumberToken | OpToken | ParenToken | EofToken;
```

```typescript
export type Result =
  | { readonly ok: true; readonly value: number }
  | { readonly ok: false; readonly error: string };
```

```typescript
function tokenize(input: string): readonly Token[] {
  const tokens: Token[] = [];
```
```typescript
  for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {
    const c = input[i];
    if (c === ' ' || c === '\t' || c === '\n' || c === '\r') continue;
    if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
      let s = '';
      while (i < input.length && input[i] >= '0' && input[i] <= '9') s += input[i++];
      tokens.push({ type: 'NUMBER', value: parseInt(s, 10) });
      continue;
    }
```
```typescript
    const type = c === '+' ? 'PLUS' : c === '-' ? 'MINUS' : c === '*' ? 'MUL' : c === '/' ? 'DIV' : c === '(' ? 'LPAREN' : c === ')' ? 'RPAREN' : null;
    if (type) tokens.push({ type });
    else throw new Error(`Unexpected character: '${c}'`);
```
```typescript
  }
  tokens.push({ type: 'EOF' });
  return tokens;
}

function parseExpr(tokens: readonly Token[], pos: number): [number, number] {
  let [val, nextPos] = parseTerm(tokens, pos);
  while (nextPos < tokens.length - 1 && (tokens[nextPos].type === 'PLUS' || tokens[nextPos].type === 'MINUS')) {
    const op = tokens[nextPos].type;
    const [rhs, newNextPos] = parseTerm(tokens, nextPos + 1);
    val = op === 'PLUS' ? val + rhs : val - rhs;
    nextPos = newNextPos;
  }
  return [val, nextPos];
}

function parseTerm(tokens: readonly Token[], pos: number): [number, number] {
  let [val, nextPos] = parseFactor(tokens, pos);
  while (nextPos < tokens.length - 1 && (tokens[nextPos].type === 'MUL' || tokens[nextPos].type === 'DIV')) {
    const op = tokens[nextPos].type;
    const [rhs, newNextPos] = parseFactor(tokens, nextPos + 1);
    if (op === 'DIV' && rhs === 0) throw new Error('Division by zero');
    val = op === 'MUL' ? val * rhs : Math.trunc(val / rhs);
    nextPos = newNextPos;
  }
  return [val, nextPos];
}

function parseFactor(tokens: readonly Token[], pos: number): [number, number] {
  if (pos >= tokens.length - 1) throw new Error('Unexpected end of input');
  const token = tokens[pos];
  if (token.type === 'NUMBER') return [token.value, pos + 1];
  if (token.type === 'LPAREN') {
    const [val, innerPos] = parseExpr(tokens, pos + 1);
    if (innerPos >= tokens.length || tokens[innerPos].type !== 'RPAREN') throw new Error('Missing closing parenthesis');
    return [val, innerPos + 1];
  }
  throw new Error(`Unexpected token: ${token.type}`);
}

export function evaluate(expr: string): Result {
  try {
    const tokens = tokenize(expr);
    const [val, endPos] = parseExpr(tokens, 0);
    if (endPos < tokens.length - 1 || tokens[endPos].type !== 'EOF') throw new Error('Unexpected trailing characters');
    return { ok: true, value: val };
  } catch (err) {
    return { ok: false, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error' };
  }
}
```

```ts
export const PERCENT_BASE = 100;

function pctOf(amount: Amount): number {
  return amount.kind === "percent" ? amount.pct : 0;
}

async function adjustmentOf(base: number, amount: Amount): Promise<number> {
  if (amount.kind === "fixed") {
    return amount.value;
  }
  if (amount.kind === "deferred") {
    return amount.load();

  const totals = await Promise.all(items.map(item => lineTotal(item)));
  return totals.reduce((sum: number, total: number): number => sum + total, 0);
}
```

```ts
import type { Clock } from "../../lib/clock";

export interface PriceCache {
  get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number>;
}

interface CacheEntry {
  readonly value: number;
  readonly expiresAt: number;
}

interface PendingEntry {
  readonly promise: Promise<number>;
}

const DEFAULT_TTL_MS = 60_000;

function isPendingEntry(entry: CacheEntry | PendingEntry): entry is PendingEntry {
  return "promise" in entry;
}

export function createPriceCache(clock: Clock, ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS): PriceCache {
  const store = new Map<string, CacheEntry | PendingEntry>();
  return {
    async get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number> {
      const existing = store.get(key);
      if (existing !== undefined) {
        if (isPendingEntry(existing)) {
          return existing.promise;
        }
        if (existing.expiresAt > clock.now()) {
          return existing.value;
        }
      }

      const promise = compute().then(
        (value) => {
          store.set(key, { value, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
          return value;
        },
        (error) => {
          store.delete(key);
          throw error;
        }
      );
      store.set(key, { promise });
      return promise;
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
  readonly promise: Promise<number>;
}

function isPendingEntry(entry: CacheEntry | PendingEntry): entry is PendingEntry {
  return "promise" in entry;

          throw error;

      return promise;
    },
  };
```

```ts
export interface PriceCache {

interface CacheEntry {

  readonly expiresAt: number;
```

import type { Clock } from "../../lib/clock";

export interface PriceCache {
  /** Return the cached total for `key` if fresh, else run `compute` and cache its result. */
  get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number>;
}

interface CacheEntry {
  readonly value: number;
  readonly expiresAt: number;
}

interface PendingEntry {
  readonly promise: Promise<number>;
}

```ts
type Entry = CacheEntry | PendingEntry;

const DEFAULT_TTL_MS = 60_000;

export function createPriceCache(clock: Clock, ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS): PriceCache {
  const entries = new Map<string, Entry>();
  return {
    async get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number> {
      const entry = entries.get(key);
      if (entry !== undefined && "value" in entry && entry.expiresAt > clock.now()) {
        return entry.value;
      }
      if (entry !== undefined && "promise" in entry) {
        return entry.promise;
      }
      const promise = compute()
        .then(value => {
          entries.set(key, { value, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
          return value;
        })
        .catch(err => {
          entries.delete(key);
          throw err;
        });
      entries.set(key, { promise });
      return promise;
    },
  };
}
```

   ```typescript
import type { Clock } from '../../lib/clock';

interface Entry<V> {
  readonly value: V;
  readonly expiresAt: number;
}

export interface LruCache<K, V> {
  get(key: K): V | undefined;
  set(key: K, value: V): void;
  has(key: K): boolean;
  readonly size: number;
}
   ```

   ```typescript
const isExpired = <V>(entry: Entry<V>, now: number): boolean => now >= entry.expiresAt;
   ```

   ```typescript
const countLive = <K, V>(store: Map<K, Entry<V>>, clock: Clock): number => {
  let count = 0;
  for (const entry of store.values()) {
    if (!isExpired(entry, clock.now())) count++;
  }
  return count;
};

const refreshRecency = <K, V>(store: Map<K, Entry<V>>, key: K, clock: Clock): void => {
  const entry = store.get(key);
  if (entry && !isExpired(entry, clock.now())) {
    store.delete(key);
    store.set(key, entry);
  }
};

const evictLru = <K, V>(store: Map<K, Entry<V>>, clock: Clock): void => {
  for (const [key, entry] of store.entries()) {
    if (!isExpired(entry, clock.now())) {
      store.delete(key);
      return;
    }
  }
};

export function createLruCache<K, V>(
  capacity: number,
  ttlMs: number,
  clock: Clock
): LruCache<K, V> {
  const store = new Map<K, Entry<V>>();
  return {
    get(key: K): V | undefined {
      const entry = store.get(key);
      if (!entry) return undefined;
      if (isExpired(entry, clock.now())) {
        store.delete(key);
        return undefined;
      }
      refreshRecency(store, key, clock);
      return entry.value;
    },
    set(key: K, value: V): void {
      const now = clock.now();
      const entry: Entry<V> = { value, expiresAt: now + ttlMs };
      if (store.has(key)) {
        store.delete(key);
        store.set(key, entry);
        return;
      }
      if (countLive(store, clock) >= capacity) evictLru(store, clock);
      store.set(key, entry);
    },
    has(key: K): boolean {
      const entry = store.get(key);
      if (!entry) return false;
      if (isExpired(entry, clock.now())) {
        store.delete(key);
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    },
    get size(): number {
      return countLive(store, clock);
    }
  };
}
   ```

```typescript
interface CacheEntry<V> {
  value: V;
  expiresAt: number;
  recency: number;
}

function isExpired(entry: CacheEntry<unknown>, now: number): boolean {
  return now >= entry.expiresAt;
}

function evictLeastRecent(entries: Map<string, CacheEntry<unknown>>, now: number): void {
```
```typescript
  let targetKey: string | undefined;
  let minRecency = Infinity;

  for (const [key, entry] of entries) {
    const recency = isExpired(entry, now) ? Infinity : entry.recency;
    if (recency < minRecency) {
      minRecency = recency;
      targetKey = key;
    }
  }

  if (targetKey !== undefined) entries.delete(targetKey);
}
```

```typescript
export interface LruCache<K, V> {
  get(key: K): V | undefined;
  set(key: K, value: V): void;
  has(key: K): boolean;
  readonly size: number;
}
```

```typescript
function initLruCache<K, V>(
  capacity: number,
  ttlMs: number,
  clock: Clock
): LruCache<K, V> {
```
```typescript
  const entries = new Map<string, CacheEntry<V>>();
  let recencyCounter = 0;

  const now = (): number => clock.now();
  const touchRecency = (): number => ++recencyCounter;

  const purgeExpired = (nowVal: number): void => {
    for (const [k, e] of entries) if (isExpired(e, nowVal)) entries.delete(k);
  };

  const handleEviction = (nowVal: number): void => {
    if (entries.size < capacity) return;
    purgeExpired(nowVal);
    if (entries.size < capacity) return;
    evictLeastRecent(entries, nowVal);
  };

  const getEntry = (key: string): CacheEntry<V> | undefined => entries.get(key);

  return {
    get(key: K): V | undefined {
      const entry = getEntry(String(key));
      if (entry === undefined || isExpired(entry, now())) {
        if (entry !== undefined) entries.delete(String(key));
        return undefined;
      }
      entry.recency = touchRecency();
      return entry.value;
    },

    set(key: K, value: V): void {
      const strKey = String(key);
      const currentNow = now();

      if (entries.has(strKey)) {
        entries.set(strKey, { value, expiresAt: currentNow + ttlMs, recency: touchRecency() });
        return;
      }

      handleEviction(currentNow);
      entries.set(strKey, { value, expiresAt: currentNow + ttlMs, recency: touchRecency() });

      const entry = getEntry(String(key));
      return entry !== undefined && !isExpired(entry, now());

    get size(): number {
      const currentNow = now();
      let count = 0;
      for (const entry of entries.values()) if (!isExpired(entry, currentNow)) count++;

    }
  };

  ttlMs: number,
```

```typescript
import { Clock } from '../../lib/clock';

interface CacheEntry<V> {
  value: V;
  expiresAt: number;
  recency: number;
}

export interface LruCache<K, V> {
  get(key: K): V | undefined;
  set(key: K, value: V): void;
  has(key: K): boolean;
  readonly size: number;
}

export function createLruCache<K, V>(
  capacity: number,
  ttlMs: number,
  clock: Clock
): LruCache<K, V> {
  const entries = new Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>();
  let recencyCounter = 0;

  const isExpired = (entry: CacheEntry<V>): boolean =>
    clock.now() >= entry.expiresAt;

  const removeExpired = (): void => {
    for (const key of entries.keys()) {
      if (isExpired(entries.get(key)!)) {
        entries.delete(key);
      }
    }
  };

  const evictLeastRecent = (): void => {
    let oldestKey: K | undefined;
    let oldestRecency = Infinity;
    for (const [key, entry] of entries) {
      if (!isExpired(entry) && entry.recency < oldestRecency) {
        oldestRecency = entry.recency;
        oldestKey = key;
      }
    }
    if (oldestKey !== undefined) {
      entries.delete(oldestKey);
    }
  };

  const bumpRecency = (): number => ++recencyCounter;

  return {
    get(key: K): V | undefined {
      removeExpired();
      const entry = entries.get(key);
      if (!entry) return undefined;
      entry.recency = bumpRecency();
      return entry.value;
    },

    set(key: K, value: V): void {
      removeExpired();
      if (entries.size >= capacity) {
        evictLeastRecent();
      }
      entries.set(key, {
        value,
        expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs,
        recency: bumpRecency(),
      });
    },

    has(key: K): boolean {
      removeExpired();
      return entries.has(key);
    },

    get size(): number {
      removeExpired();
      return entries.size;
    },
  };
}
```

```typescript
import { Clock } from '../../lib/clock';
```

```typescript
interface CacheEntry<V> {
  value: V;
  expiresAt: number;
  recency: number;
}

export interface LruCache<K, V> {
  get(key: K): V | undefined;
  set(key: K, value: V): void;
  has(key: K): boolean;
  readonly size: number;
}

export function createLruCache<K, V>(
  capacity: number,
  ttlMs: number,
  clock: Clock
): LruCache<K, V> {
  const entries = new Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>();
  let recencyCounter = 0;

  const isExpired = (entry: CacheEntry<V>): boolean =>
    clock.now() >= entry.expiresAt;

  const removeExpired = (): void => {
    for (const key of entries.keys()) {
      const entry = entries.get(key);
      if (entry && isExpired(entry)) {
        entries.delete(key);
      }
    }
  };

  const evictLeastRecent = (): void => {
    let oldestKey: K | undefined;
    let oldestRecency = Infinity;
    for (const [key, entry] of entries) {
      if (!isExpired(entry) && entry.recency < oldestRecency) {
        oldestRecency = entry.recency;
        oldestKey = key;
      }
    }
    if (oldestKey !== undefined) {
      entries.delete(oldestKey);
    }
  };

  const bumpRecency = (): number => ++recencyCounter;

  return {
    get(key: K): V | undefined {
      removeExpired();
      const entry = entries.get(key);
      if (!entry) return undefined;
      entry.recency = bumpRecency();
      return entry.value;
    },

    set(key: K, value: V): void {
      removeExpired();
      if (entries.size >= capacity) {
        evictLeastRecent();
      }
      entries.set(key, {
        value,
        expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs,
        recency: bumpRecency(),
      });
    },

    has(key: K): boolean {
      removeExpired();
      return entries.has(key);
    },

    get size(): number {
      removeExpired();
      return entries.size;
    },
  };
}
```

```typescript
  clock: Clock = systemClock
```

describe('evaluate', () => {
  describe('basic arithmetic', () => {
    it('should return correct value for simple addition when operands are positive', () => {
      const result: Result = evaluate('2 + 3');
      expect(result).toEqual({ ok: true, value: 5 });
    });

    it('should return correct value for simple subtraction when operands are positive', () => {
      const result: Result = evaluate('10 - 4');
      expect(result).toEqual({ ok: true, value: 6 });
    });

    it('should return correct value for simple multiplication when operands are positive', () => {
      const result: Result = evaluate('3 * 4');
      expect(result).toEqual({ ok: true, value: 12 });
    });

    it('should return correct value for simple division when operands divide evenly', () => {
      const result: Result = evaluate('8 / 2');
      expect(result).toEqual({ ok: true, value: 4 });
    });
  });

  describe('precedence', () => {
    it('should multiply before add when mixed operators are present', () => {
      const result: Result = evaluate('2 + 3 * 4');
      expect(result).toEqual({ ok: true, value: 14 });
    });

    it('should divide before subtract when mixed operators are present', () => {
      const result: Result = evaluate('10 - 8 / 2');
      expect(result).toEqual({ ok: true, value: 6 });
    });
  });

  describe('left-associativity', () => {
    it('should evaluate 10-3-2 as 5 when subtraction is chained', () => {
      const result: Result = evaluate('10 - 3 - 2');
      expect(result).toEqual({ ok: true, value: 5 });
    });

    it('should evaluate 8/2/2 as 2 when division is chained', () => {
      const result: Result = evaluate('8 / 2 / 2');
      expect(result).toEqual({ ok: true, value: 2 });
    });
  });

  describe('parentheses', () => {
    it('should override precedence when parentheses are used', () => {
      const result: Result = evaluate('(2 + 3) * 4');
      expect(result).toEqual({ ok: true, value: 20 });
    });

    it('should handle nested parentheses correctly', () => {
      const result: Result = evaluate('((2 + 3) * (4 - 1))');
      expect(result).toEqual({ ok: true, value: 15 });
    });
  });

  describe('whitespace handling', () => {
    it('should ignore arbitrary whitespace when spaces surround operators', () => {
      const result: Result = evaluate('  2   +   3  ');
      expect(result).toEqual({ ok: true, value: 5 });
    });
  });

  describe('error handling', () => {
    it('should return error for division by zero when divisor is zero', () => {
      const result: Result = evaluate('10 / 0');
      expect(result).toEqual({ ok: false, error: 'Division by zero' });
    });

    it('should return error for unbalanced parentheses when closing is missing', () => {
      const result: Result = evaluate('(2 + 3');
      expect(result).toEqual({ ok: false, error: 'Unbalanced parentheses' });
    });

    it('should return error for unexpected characters when non-numeric tokens appear', () => {
      const result: Result = evaluate('2 + a');
      expect(result).toEqual({ ok: false, error: 'Unexpected: a' });
    });

    it('should return error for missing operand when operator lacks right side', () => {
      const result: Result = evaluate('2 +');
      expect(result).toEqual({ ok: false, error: 'Missing operand' });
    });
  });
});

     ```typescript
  | { readonly ok: true; readonly value: number }
  | { readonly ok: false; readonly error: string };

type Token =
  | { readonly type: 'num'; readonly value: number }
  | { readonly type: 'op'; readonly value: '+' | '-' | '*' | '/' }
  | { readonly type: 'paren'; readonly value: '(' | ')' };

export function evaluate(expr: string): Result {
  const tokRes = tokenize(expr);
  if (!tokRes.ok) return tokRes;
  const cursor = { pos: 0 };
  const res = parseExpr(tokRes.value, cursor);
  if (!res.ok) return res;
  if (cursor.pos < tokRes.value.length) return { ok: false, error: 'Unexpected input' };
  return res;
}

function tokenize(input: string): Result<readonly Token[]> {
  const tokens: Token[] = [];
  let i = 0;
  while (i < input.length) {
    const ch = input[i];
    if (ch === ' ') { i++; continue; }
     ```
     ```typescript
    if (ch === '+' || ch === '-' || ch === '*' || ch === '/') { tokens.push({ type: 'op', value: ch }); i++; continue; }
    if (ch === '(' || ch === ')') { tokens.push({ type: 'paren', value: ch }); i++; continue; }
    if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
      let num = ''; while (i < input.length && input[i] >= '0' && input[i] <= '9') { num += input[i]; i++; }
      tokens.push({ type: 'num', value: Number(num) }); continue;
    }
    return { ok: false, error: `Unexpected character: ${ch}` };
  }
  return { ok: true, value: tokens };
}
     ```

     ```typescript
function parseExpr(tokens: readonly Token[], c: { pos: number }): Result<number> {
  let left = parseTerm(tokens, c);
  if (!left.ok) return left;
  while (c.pos < tokens.length) {
    const t = tokens[c.pos];

      if (!right.ok) return right;
      left = { ok: true, value: t.value === '+' ? left.value + right.value : left.value - right.value };
    } else break;

  return left;
}
     ```

     ```typescript
  while (c.pos < tokens.length) {
    const t = tokens[c.pos];

      left = { ok: true, value: t.value === '*' ? left.value * right.value : left.value / right.value };
    } else break;
  }
  return left;
}
     ```

     ```typescript
function parseFactor(tokens: readonly Token[], c: { pos: number }): Result<number> {
  if (c.pos >= tokens.length) return { ok: false, error: 'Missing operand' };
     ```

```ts
import type { Clock } from "../../lib/clock";

export interface PriceCache {
  get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number>;
}

interface CacheEntry {
  readonly value: number;
  readonly expiresAt: number;
}

const DEFAULT_TTL_MS = 60_000;

export function createPriceCache(clock: Clock, ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS): PriceCache {
  const entries = new Map<string, CacheEntry>();
  const pending = new Map<string, Promise<number>>();

  return {
    async get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number> {
      const hit = entries.get(key);
      if (hit !== undefined && hit.expiresAt > clock.now()) {
        return hit.value;
      }

      const existingPromise = pending.get(key);
      if (existingPromise !== undefined) {
        return existingPromise;
      }

      const promise = compute()
        .then((value: number) => {
          entries.set(key, { value, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
          return value;
        })
        .catch((error: unknown) => {
          pending.delete(key);
          throw error;
        })
        .finally(() => {
          pending.delete(key);
        });

      pending.set(key, promise);
      return promise;
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
import type { Clock } from "../../lib/clock";

export interface PriceCache {
  get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number>;
}

interface CacheEntry {
  readonly value: number;
  readonly expiresAt: number;
}

const DEFAULT_TTL_MS = 60_000;

export function createPriceCache(clock: Clock, ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS): PriceCache {
  const entries = new Map<string, CacheEntry>();
  const pending = new Map<string, Promise<number>>();

  return {
    async get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number> {
      const hit = entries.get(key);
      if (hit !== undefined && hit.expiresAt > clock.now()) {
        return hit.value;
      }

      const existingPromise = pending.get(key);
      if (existingPromise !== undefined) {
        return existingPromise;
      }

      const promise = compute()
        .then((value: number) => {
          entries.set(key, { value, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
          return value;
        })
        .finally(() => {
          pending.delete(key);
        });

      pending.set(key, promise);
      return promise;
    },
  };
}
```

export type Amount =
  | { readonly kind: "fixed"; readonly value: number }
  | { readonly kind: "percent"; readonly pct: number }
  | { readonly kind: "deferred"; readonly load: () => Promise<number> };

export interface LineItem {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly base: number;
  readonly adjustment: Amount;
}

// FILE: pricing.ts
import type { Amount, LineItem } from "./types";

export const PERCENT_BASE = 100;

function pctOf(amount: Amount): number {
  return amount.kind === "percent" ? amount.pct : 0;
}

async function adjustmentOf(base: number, amount: Amount): Promise<number> {
  if (amount.kind === "fixed") {
    return amount.value;
  }
  if (amount.kind === "percent") {
    return (base * pctOf(amount)) / PERCENT_BASE;
  }
  return amount.load();
}

export async function lineTotal(item: LineItem): Promise<number> {
  return item.base + await adjustmentOf(item.base, item.adjustment);
}

export async function computeTotal(items: readonly LineItem[]): Promise<number> {
  const totals = await Promise.all(items.map(item => lineTotal(item)));
  return totals.reduce((sum: number, t: number): number => sum + t, 0);
}

// FILE: report.ts
import type { Amount, LineItem } from "./types";
import { lineTotal } from "./pricing";

const KIND_LABEL: Partial<Record<Amount["kind"], string>> = {
  fixed: "flat",
  percent: "rate",
  deferred: "deferred",
};
const UNKNOWN_LABEL = "other";

export function amountLabel(amount: Amount): string {
  return KIND_LABEL[amount.kind] ?? UNKNOWN_LABEL;
}

export async function reportLine(item: LineItem): Promise<string> {
  const total = await lineTotal(item);
  return `${item.id} [${amountLabel(item.adjustment)}]: ${String(total)}`;
}

export async function buildReport(items: readonly LineItem[]): Promise<readonly string[]> {
  const lines = await Promise.all(items.map(item => reportLine(item)));
  return lines;
}

        export interface PriceCache {
          get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number>;
        }

        interface CacheEntry {
          readonly value: number;
          readonly expiresAt: number;

        const DEFAULT_TTL_MS = 60_000;

        export function createPriceCache(clock: Clock, ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS): PriceCache {

        ```ts
          const pending = new Map<string, Promise<number>>();

              const hit = entries.get(key);
              if (hit !== undefined && hit.expiresAt > clock.now()) {

                  pending.delete(key);

                },
                (error) => {
                  pending.delete(key);
                  throw error;
                }
              );

              pending.set(key, promise);
              return promise;
            },
          };
        }
        ```

    ```ts
import type { Amount, LineItem } from "./types";

export const PERCENT_BASE = 100;

function pctOf(amount: Amount): number {
  return amount.kind === "percent" ? amount.pct : 0;
}

function syncAdjustmentOf(base: number, amount: Amount): number {
  if (amount.kind === "fixed") return amount.value;
  return (base * pctOf(amount)) / PERCENT_BASE;
}

export async function lineTotal(item: LineItem): Promise<number> {
  const adj =
    item.adjustment.kind === "deferred"
      ? await item.adjustment.load()
      : syncAdjustmentOf(item.base, item.adjustment);
  return item.base + adj;
}

export async function computeTotal(items: readonly LineItem[]): Promise<number> {
  let sum = 0;
  for (const item of items) {
    sum += await lineTotal(item);
  }
  return sum;
}
    ```

    ```ts
const KIND_LABEL: Partial<Record<Amount["kind"], string>> = {
  fixed: "flat",
  percent: "rate",
  deferred: "deferred",
};
const UNKNOWN_LABEL = "other";

export function amountLabel(amount: Amount): string {
  return KIND_LABEL[amount.kind] ?? UNKNOWN_LABEL;
}

export async function reportLine(item: LineItem): Promise<string> {
  const total = await lineTotal(item);
  return `${item.id} [${amountLabel(item.adjustment)}]: ${String(total)}`;
}

export async function buildReport(items: readonly LineItem[]): Promise<readonly string[]> {
  return Promise.all(items.map(reportLine));
}
    ```

    ```ts
import type { Clock } from "../../lib/clock";

export interface PriceCache {
  get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number>;
}

interface CacheEntry {
  readonly value: number;
  readonly expiresAt: number;
}

const DEFAULT_TTL_MS = 60_000;

export function createPriceCache(clock: Clock, ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS): PriceCache {
  const entries = new Map<string, CacheEntry>();
  const pending = new Map<string, Promise<number>>();

  return {
    async get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number> {
      const hit = entries.get(key);
    ```
    ```ts
      if (hit !== undefined && hit.expiresAt > clock.now()) return hit.value;
      const existingPending = pending.get(key);
      if (existingPending !== undefined) return existingPending;
      const promise = compute().then(
        (value) => {
          entries.set(key, { value, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
          pending.delete(key);
          return value;
        },
        (error) => {
          pending.delete(key);
          throw error;
        }
      );
      pending.set(key, promise);
      return promise;
    ```
    },
  };
}

```typescript
interface CacheEntry<V> {
  value: V;
  expiresAt: number;
  recency: number;
}
```

```typescript
}

function evictLeastRecent(entries: Map<string, CacheEntry<unknown>>, now: number): void {
  let targetKey: string | undefined;
  let minRecency = Infinity;

  for (const [key, entry] of entries) {
    const recency = isExpired(entry, now) ? Infinity : entry.recency;
    if (recency < minRecency) {
      minRecency = recency;
      targetKey = key;
    }
  }

  if (targetKey !== undefined) entries.delete(targetKey);
}

export interface LruCache<K, V> {
  get(key: K): V | undefined;
  set(key: K, value: V): void;
  has(key: K): boolean;
  readonly size: number;
}

export function createLruCache<K, V>(
  capacity: number,
  ttlMs: number,
  clock: Clock
): LruCache<K, V> {
  const entries = new Map<string, CacheEntry<V>>();
  let recencyCounter = 0;

  const now = (): number => clock.now();
  const touchRecency = (): number => ++recencyCounter;

  const purgeExpired = (nowVal: number): void => {
    for (const [k, e] of entries) if (isExpired(e, nowVal)) entries.delete(k);
  };

  const handleEviction = (nowVal: number): void => {
    if (entries.size < capacity) return;
    purgeExpired(nowVal);
    if (entries.size < capacity) return;
    evictLeastRecent(entries, nowVal);
  };

  const getEntry = (key: string): CacheEntry<V> | undefined => entries.get(key);

  return {
    get(key: K): V | undefined {
      const entry = getEntry(String(key));
      if (!entry || isExpired(entry, now())) {
        if (entry) entries.delete(String(key));
        return undefined;
      }
      entry.recency = touchRecency();
      return entry.value;
    },

    set(key: K, value: V): void {
      const strKey = String(key);
      const currentNow = now();

      if (entries.has(strKey)) {
        entries.set(strKey, { value, expiresAt: currentNow + ttlMs, recency: touchRecency() });
        return;
      }

      handleEviction(currentNow);
      entries.set(strKey, { value, expiresAt: currentNow + ttlMs, recency: touchRecency() });
    },

    has(key: K): boolean {
      const entry = getEntry(String(key));
      return !!entry && !isExpired(entry, now());
    },

    get size(): number {
      const currentNow = now();
      let count = 0;
      for (const entry of entries.values()) if (!isExpired(entry, currentNow)) count++;
      return count;
    }
  };
}
```

```typescript
import type { Clock } from '../../lib/clock';
```

```typescript
interface CacheEntry<V> {
  value: V;
  expiresAt: number;
  recency: number;
}

function isExpired(entry: CacheEntry<unknown>, now: number): boolean {
  return now >= entry.expiresAt;
}

function evictLeastRecent(entries: Map<string, CacheEntry<unknown>>, now: number): void {
  let targetKey: string | undefined;
  let minRecency = Infinity;

  for (const [key, entry] of entries) {
    const recency = isExpired(entry, now) ? Infinity : entry.recency;
    if (recency < minRecency) {
      minRecency = recency;
      targetKey = key;
    }
  }

  if (targetKey !== undefined) entries.delete(targetKey);
}

export interface LruCache<K, V> {
  get(key: K): V | undefined;
  set(key: K, value: V): void;
  has(key: K): boolean;
  readonly size: number;
}
```

```typescript
function buildLruCache<K, V>(
  capacity: number,
  ttlMs: number,
  clock: Clock
): LruCache<K, V> {
  const entries = new Map<string, CacheEntry<V>>();
  let recencyCounter = 0;

  const now = (): number => clock.now();
  const touchRecency = (): number => ++recencyCounter;

  const purgeExpired = (nowVal: number): void => {
    for (const [k, e] of entries) if (isExpired(e, nowVal)) entries.delete(k);
  };

  const handleEviction = (nowVal: number): void => {
    if (entries.size < capacity) return;
    purgeExpired(nowVal);
    if (entries.size < capacity) return;
    evictLeastRecent(entries, nowVal);
  };

  const getEntry = (key: string): CacheEntry<V> | undefined => entries.get(key);

  return {
    get(key: K): V | undefined {
      const entry = getEntry(String(key));
      if (entry === undefined || isExpired(entry, now())) {
        if (entry !== undefined) entries.delete(String(key));
        return undefined;
      }
      entry.recency = touchRecency();
      return entry.value;
    },

    set(key: K, value: V): void {
      const strKey = String(key);
      const currentNow = now();

      if (entries.has(strKey)) {
        entries.set(strKey, { value, expiresAt: currentNow + ttlMs, recency: touchRecency() });
        return;
      }

      handleEviction(currentNow);
      entries.set(strKey, { value, expiresAt: currentNow + ttlMs, recency: touchRecency() });
    },

    has(key: K): boolean {
      const entry = getEntry(String(key));
      return entry !== undefined && !isExpired(entry, now());
    },

    get size(): number {
      const currentNow = now();
      let count = 0;
      for (const entry of entries.values()) if (!isExpired(entry, currentNow)) count++;
      return count;
    }
  };
}

export function createLruCache<K, V>(
  capacity: number,
  ttlMs: number,
  clock: Clock
): LruCache<K, V> {
  return buildLruCache(capacity, ttlMs, clock);
}
```

```typescript
const DEFAULT_CAPACITY = 1;

interface Bucket {
  tokens: number;
```

```ts
import type { Clock } from "../../lib/clock";

export interface PriceCache {
  get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number>;
}

interface CacheEntry {
  readonly value: number;
  readonly expiresAt: number;
}

const DEFAULT_TTL_MS = 60_000;

export function createPriceCache(clock: Clock, ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS): PriceCache {
  const entries = new Map<string, CacheEntry>();
  const pending = new Map<string, Promise<number>>();

  return {
    async get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number> {
      const hit = entries.get(key);
      if (hit !== undefined && hit.expiresAt > clock.now()) {
        return hit.value;
      }

      const existingPromise = pending.get(key);
      if (existingPromise !== undefined) {
        return existingPromise;
      }

      const promise = compute()
        .then((value: number) => {
          entries.set(key, { value, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
          return value;
        })
        .catch((error: unknown) => {
          pending.delete(key);
          throw error;
        })
        .finally(() => {
          pending.delete(key);
        });

      pending.set(key, promise);
      return promise;
    },
  };
}
```

- failed computation is never cached
- entries expire after TTL
- different keys stay independent

```ts
  | { readonly kind: "fixed"; readonly value: number }
  | { readonly kind: "percent"; readonly pct: number }
```

// FILE: pricing.ts
import type { Amount, LineItem } from "./types";

export const PERCENT_BASE = 100;

function adjustmentOf(base: number, amount: Amount): number | Promise<number> {
  if (amount.kind === "fixed") return amount.value;
  if (amount.kind === "percent") return (base * amount.pct) / PERCENT_BASE;
  return amount.load();
}

export async function lineTotal(item: LineItem): Promise<number> {
  const adjustment = await adjustmentOf(item.base, item.adjustment);
  return item.base + adjustment;
}

export async function computeTotal(items: readonly LineItem[]): Promise<number> {
  const totals = await Promise.all(items.map((item: LineItem): Promise<number> => lineTotal(item)));
  return totals.reduce((sum: number, total: number): number => sum + total, 0);
}

import type { Amount, LineItem } from "./types";
import { lineTotal } from "./pricing";

const KIND_LABEL: Partial<Record<Amount["kind"], string>> = {
  fixed: "flat",
  percent: "rate",
  deferred: "deferred",
};
const UNKNOWN_LABEL = "other";

export function amountLabel(amount: Amount): string {
  return KIND_LABEL[amount.kind] ?? UNKNOWN_LABEL;
}

export async function reportLine(item: LineItem): Promise<string> {
  const total = await lineTotal(item);
  return `${item.id} [${amountLabel(item.adjustment)}]: ${String(total)}`;
}

export async function buildReport(items: readonly LineItem[]): Promise<readonly string[]> {
  return Promise.all(items.map((item: LineItem): Promise<string> => reportLine(item)));
}

    ```ts
export async function lineTotal(item: LineItem): Promise<number> {
  return item.base + await adjustmentOf(item.base, item.adjustment);
}

export async function computeTotal(items: readonly LineItem[]): Promise<number> {
  const totals = await Promise.all(items.map(item => lineTotal(item)));
  return totals.reduce((sum: number, t: number): number => sum + t, 0);
}
    ```

    ```ts
import type { Clock } from "../../lib/clock";

export interface PriceCache {
  get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number>;
}

interface CacheEntry {
  readonly value: number;
  readonly expiresAt: number;
}

interface PendingEntry {
  readonly promise: Promise<number>;
}

const DEFAULT_TTL_MS = 60_000;

export function createPriceCache(clock: Clock, ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS): PriceCache {
  const entries = new Map<string, CacheEntry>();
  const pending = new Map<string, PendingEntry>();

  return {
    async get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number> {
      const hit = entries.get(key);
      if (hit !== undefined && hit.expiresAt > clock.now()) {
        return hit.value;
      }
    ```

    ```ts
      const existing = pending.get(key);
      if (existing !== undefined) {
        return existing.promise;
      }

      const promise = compute().then((value: number): number => {
        entries.set(key, { value, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
        return value;
    ```
    ```ts
      }).finally(() => pending.delete(key));

      pending.set(key, { promise });
      return promise;
    },
    ```
    ```ts
  };
}
    ```

import type { Amount, LineItem } from "./types";

export const PERCENT_BASE = 100;

function pctOf(amount: Amount): number {
  return amount.kind === "percent" ? amount.pct : 0;
}

        ```ts
function syncAdjustmentOf(base: number, amount: Amount): number {
  if (amount.kind === "fixed") return amount.value;
  return (base * pctOf(amount)) / PERCENT_BASE;
}

export async function lineTotal(item: LineItem): Promise<number> {
  const adj =
    item.adjustment.kind === "deferred"
      ? await item.adjustment.load()
      : syncAdjustmentOf(item.base, item.adjustment);
  return item.base + adj;
}

export async function computeTotal(items: readonly LineItem[]): Promise<number> {
        ```
        ```ts
  let sum = 0;
  for (const item of items) {
    sum += await lineTotal(item);
  }
  return sum;
}
        ```

```typescript
import type { Clock } from '../../lib/clock';

export interface LruCache<K, V> {
  get(key: K): V | undefined;
  set(key: K, value: V): void;
  has(key: K): boolean;
  readonly size: number;
}

interface CacheEntry<V> {
  value: V;
  expiresAt: number;
}

const isExpired = <V>(entry: CacheEntry<V>, now: number): boolean =>
  now >= entry.expiresAt;

const evictOldestLive = <K, V>(store: Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>, now: number): void => {
  for (const [key, entry] of store) {
    if (!isExpired(entry, now)) {
      store.delete(key);
      return;
    }
  }
};

const countLive = <V>(store: Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>, now: number): number => {
  let count = 0;
  for (const entry of store.values()) {
    if (!isExpired(entry, now)) count++;
  }
  return count;
};

const touchRecency = <V>(store: Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>, key: K, ttlMs: number, now: number): void => {
  const entry = store.get(key);
  if (entry !== undefined) {
    store.delete(key);
    store.set(key, { ...entry, expiresAt: now + ttlMs });
  }
};

export function createLruCache<K, V>(
  capacity: number,
  ttlMs: number,
  clock: Clock
): LruCache<K, V> {
  const store = new Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>();
  const now = (): number => clock.now();

  return {
    get(key: K): V | undefined {
      const entry = store.get(key);
      if (entry === undefined || isExpired(entry, now())) {
        store.delete(key);
        return undefined;
      }
      touchRecency(store, key, ttlMs, now());
      return entry.value;
    },

    set(key: K, value: V): void {
      if (capacity <= 0) return;
      if (store.has(key)) store.delete(key);
      while (countLive(store, now()) >= capacity) evictOldestLive(store, now());
      store.set(key, { value, expiresAt: now() + ttlMs });
    },

    has(key: K): boolean {
      const entry = store.get(key);
      return entry !== undefined && !isExpired(entry, now());
    },

    get size(): number {
      return countLive(store, now());
    },
  };
}
```

```typescript
import type { Clock } from '../../lib/clock';
```

export interface LruCache<K, V> {
  get(key: K): V | undefined;
  set(key: K, value: V): void;
  has(key: K): boolean;
  readonly size: number;
}

interface CacheEntry<V> {
  value: V;
  expiresAt: number;
}

export function createLruCache<K, V>(
  capacity: number,
  ttlMs: number,
  clock: Clock
): LruCache<K, V> {
  const store = new Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>();

```typescript
  const isExpired = (entry: CacheEntry<V>): boolean =>
    clock.now() >= entry.expiresAt;

  const removeExpired = (): void => {
    for (const [key, entry] of store) {
      if (isExpired(entry)) {
        store.delete(key);
      }
    }
  };

  const evictLeastRecent = (): void => {
    if (store.size <= capacity) return;
    const oldestKey = store.keys().next().value;
    if (oldestKey !== undefined) {
      store.delete(oldestKey);
    }
  };

  return {
    get(key: K): V | undefined {
      const entry = store.get(key);
      if (!entry || isExpired(entry)) {
        store.delete(key);
        return undefined;
      }
      store.delete(key);
      store.set(key, { ...entry, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
      return entry.value;
    },

    set(key: K, value: V): void {
      const now = clock.now();
      const entry: CacheEntry<V> = { value, expiresAt: now + ttlMs };

      if (store.has(key)) {
        store.delete(key);
      } else {
        removeExpired();
        evictLeastRecent();
      }
      store.set(key, entry);
    },

    has(key: K): boolean {
      const entry = store.get(key);
      if (!entry || isExpired(entry)) {
        store.delete(key);
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    },

    get size(): number {
      removeExpired();
      return store.size;
    },
  };
}
```

export type Result =
  | { readonly ok: true; readonly value: number }
  | { readonly ok: false; readonly error: string };

type Token =
  | { readonly type: 'num'; readonly value: number }
  | { readonly type: 'op'; readonly value: '+' | '-' | '*' | '/' }
  | { readonly type: 'paren'; readonly value: '(' | ')' };

function peek(tokens: readonly Token[], pos: number): Token | undefined {
  return tokens[pos];
}

function tokenize(expr: string): readonly Token[] {
  const tokens: Token[] = [];
  let i = 0;
  while (i < expr.length) {
    if (expr[i] === ' ') { i++; continue; }
    if (/\d/.test(expr[i])) {
      let s = '';
      while (i < expr.length && /\d/.test(expr[i])) s += expr[i++];
      tokens.push({ type: 'num', value: Number(s) }); continue;
    }
    if ('+-*/()'.includes(expr[i])) {
      const v = expr[i] as '+' | '-' | '*' | '/' | '(' | ')';
      tokens.push({ type: v === '(' || v === ')' ? 'paren' : 'op', value: v }); i++; continue;
    }
    throw new Error(`Unexpected character: ${expr[i]}`);
  }
  return tokens;
}

function parseFactor(tokens: readonly Token[], pos: number): Result & { readonly nextPos: number } {
  const tok = peek(tokens, pos);
  if (!tok) return { ok: false, error: 'Missing operand' } as const;
  if (tok.type === 'num') return { ok: true, value: tok.value, nextPos: pos + 1 } as const;
  if (tok.type === 'paren' && tok.value === '(') {
    const inner = parseExpr(tokens, pos + 1);
    if (!inner.ok) return inner;
    const close = peek(tokens, inner.nextPos);
    if (!close || close.type !== 'paren' || close.value !== ')') return { ok: false, error: 'Unbalanced parentheses' } as const;
    return { ok: true, value: inner.value, nextPos: inner.nextPos + 1 } as const;
  }
  return { ok: false, error: 'Unexpected token' } as const;
}

function parseTerm(tokens: readonly Token[], pos: number): Result & { readonly nextPos: number } {
  let res = parseFactor(tokens, pos);
  if (!res.ok) return res;
  let cur = res.nextPos;
  while (true) {
    const tok = peek(tokens, cur);
    if (!tok || tok.type !== 'op' || (tok.value !== '*' && tok.value !== '/')) break;

    res = { ok: true, value: tok.value === '*' ? res.value * right.value : res.value / right.value, nextPos: right.nextPos } as const;
    cur = right.nextPos;
  }
  return res;
}

function parseExpr(tokens: readonly Token[], pos: number): Result & { readonly nextPos: number } {
  let res = parseTerm(tokens, pos);
  if (!res.ok) return res;
  let cur = res.nextPos;

}

   ```typescript
  if (!tok || tok.type === 'EOF') return { ok: false, error: 'Unexpected EOF' };
  if (tok.type === 'NUMBER') return { ok: true, value: { value: tok.value, idx: idx + 1 } };
  if (tok.type === 'MINUS') {
   ```
   ```typescript
    const r = parseFactor(tokens, idx + 1);
    return r.ok ? { ok: true, value: { value: -r.value.value, idx: r.value.idx } } : r;
  }
  if (tok.type === 'LPAREN') {
    const r = parseExpr(tokens, idx + 1);
    if (!r.ok) return r;
    if (tokens[r.value.idx]?.type !== 'RPAREN') return { ok: false, error: 'Missing )' };
    return { ok: true, value: { value: r.value.value, idx: r.value.idx + 1 } };
  }
  return { ok: false, error: `Unexpected: ${tok.type}` };
};
   ```

   ```typescript
export const evaluate = (expr: string): Result<number> => {
  const tokens = tokenize(expr);
  if (!tokens.ok) return tokens;
  const res = parseExpr(tokens.value, 0);
  if (!res.ok) return res;
  if (tokens.value[res.value.idx]?.type !== 'EOF') {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Unexpected trailing tokens' };
  }
  return { ok: true, value: res.value.value };
};
   ```

import type { Clock } from "../../lib/clock";

export interface PriceCache {
  /** Return the cached total for `key` if fresh, else run `compute` and cache its result. */
  get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number>;
}

interface CacheEntry {
  readonly value: number;
  readonly expiresAt: number;
}

const DEFAULT_TTL_MS = 60_000;

export function createPriceCache(clock: Clock, ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS): PriceCache {
  const entries = new Map<string, CacheEntry>();
  const pending = new Map<string, Promise<number>>();

  const runCompute = async (key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number> => {
    const promise = compute().then((value) => {
      entries.set(key, { value, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
      pending.delete(key);
      return value;
    }).catch((err) => {
      pending.delete(key);
      throw err;
    });
    pending.set(key, promise);
    return promise;
  };

  return {
    async get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number> {
      const hit = entries.get(key);
      if (hit !== undefined && hit.expiresAt > clock.now()) {
        return hit.value;
      }
      const existing = pending.get(key);
      if (existing !== undefined) {
        return existing;
      }
      return runCompute(key, compute);
    },
  };
}

   ```ts
   import type { Clock } from "../../lib/clock";

   export interface PriceCache {
     get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number>;
   }

   interface CacheEntry {
     readonly value: number;
     readonly expiresAt: number;
   }

   const DEFAULT_TTL_MS = 60_000;

   export function createPriceCache(clock: Clock, ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS): PriceCache {
     const entries = new Map<string, CacheEntry>();
     const pending = new Map<string, Promise<number>>();

     return {
       async get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number> {
         const hit = entries.get(key);
         if (hit !== undefined && hit.expiresAt > clock.now()) {
           return hit.value;
         }

         const existingPending = pending.get(key);
         if (existingPending !== undefined) {
           return existingPending;

         const promise = (async () => {
           try {
             const value = await compute();
             entries.set(key, { value, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
             return value;
           } finally {
             pending.delete(key);
           }
         })();

         pending.set(key, promise);
         return promise;
       },
     };
   }
   ```

export type Amount =
  | { readonly kind: "fixed"; readonly value: number }
  | { readonly kind: "percent"; readonly pct: number }
  | { readonly kind: "deferred"; readonly load: () => Promise<number> };

export interface LineItem {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly base: number;
  readonly adjustment: Amount;
}

// FILE: pricing.ts
import type { Amount, LineItem } from "./types";

export const PERCENT_BASE = 100;

function pctOf(amount: Amount): number {
  return amount.kind === "percent" ? amount.pct : 0;
}

async function adjustmentOf(base: number, amount: Amount): Promise<number> {
  if (amount.kind === "fixed") return amount.value;
  if (amount.kind === "percent") return (base * pctOf(amount)) / PERCENT_BASE;
  return amount.load();
}

export async function lineTotal(item: LineItem): Promise<number> {
  return item.base + await adjustmentOf(item.base, item.adjustment);
}

export async function computeTotal(items: readonly LineItem[]): Promise<number> {
  const totals = await Promise.all(items.map(lineTotal));
  return totals.reduce((sum: number, total: number): number => sum + total, 0);
}

// FILE: report.ts
import type { Amount, LineItem } from "./types";
import { lineTotal } from "./pricing";

const KIND_LABEL: Partial<Record<Amount["kind"], string>> = {
  fixed: "flat",
  percent: "rate",
  deferred: "deferred",
};
const UNKNOWN_LABEL = "other";

export function amountLabel(amount: Amount): string {
  return KIND_LABEL[amount.kind] ?? UNKNOWN_LABEL;
}

export async function reportLine(item: LineItem): Promise<string> {
  const total = await lineTotal(item);
  return `${item.id} [${amountLabel(item.adjustment)}]: ${String(total)}`;
}

export async function buildReport(items: readonly LineItem[]): Promise<readonly string[]> {
  const lines = await Promise.all(items.map(reportLine));
  return lines;
}

import type { Clock } from "../../lib/clock";

export interface PriceCache {
  get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number>;
}

interface CacheEntry {
  readonly value: number;
  readonly expiresAt: number;
}

const DEFAULT_TTL_MS = 60_000;

export function createPriceCache(clock: Clock, ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS): PriceCache {
  const entries = new Map<string, CacheEntry>();
  const pending = new Map<string, Promise<number>>();
  return {
    async get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number> {
      const hit = entries.get(key);
      if (hit !== undefined && hit.expiresAt > clock.now()) return hit.value;
      const existingPending = pending.get(key);
      if (existingPending !== undefined) return existingPending;
      const promise = (async () => {
        try {
          const value = await compute();
          entries.set(key, { value, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
          return value;
        } finally { pending.delete(key); }
      })();
      pending.set(key, promise);
      return promise;
    },
  };
}
