import type { Clock } from "../../lib/clock";

export interface PriceCache {
  get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number>;
}

interface CacheEntry {
  readonly value: number;
  readonly expiresAt: number;
}

const DEFAULT_TTL_MS = 60_000;

export function createPriceCache(clock: Clock, ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS): PriceCache {
  const entries = new Map<string, CacheEntry>();
  const pending = new Map<string, Promise<number>>();
  return {
    async get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number> {
      const hit = entries.get(key);
      if (hit !== undefined && hit.expiresAt > clock.now()) return hit.value;
      const existingPending = pending.get(key);
      if (existingPending !== undefined) return existingPending;
      const promise = (async () => {
        try {
          const value = await compute();
          entries.set(key, { value, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
          return value;
        } finally {
          pending.delete(key);
        }
      })();
      pending.set(key, promise);
      return promise;
   ```typescript
    },
   ```
   ```typescript
  };
   ```

  get(key: K): V | undefined;
  set(key: K, value: V): void;

  ttlMs: number,
  clock: Clock

        entries.delete(key);
        return;
      }
    }
  };

    for (const entry of entries.values()) {
      if (isExpired(entry) === false) count++;

    return count;

    get(key: K): V | undefined {
      const entry = entries.get(key);
      if (entry === undefined || isExpired(entry) === true) {
        entries.delete(key);
        return undefined;
      }
      const liveValue = entry.value;
      entries.delete(key);
      entries.set(key, { value: liveValue, expiresAt: entry.expiresAt });
      return liveValue;

    set(key: K, value: V): void {
      if (entries.has(key) === true) {
        entries.delete(key);
        entries.set(key, { value, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
        return;

```typescript
  };
```

```typescript
import type { Clock } from '../../lib/clock';

export interface LruCache<K, V> {
  get(key: K): V | undefined;
  set(key: K, value: V): void;
  has(key: K): boolean;
  readonly size: number;
}

export function createLruCache<K, V>(capacity: number, ttlMs: number, clock: Clock): LruCache<K, V> {
  const entries = new Map<K, { value: V; insertedAt: number }>();
  const accessOrder: K[] = [];

  const isExpired = (entry: { insertedAt: number }): boolean =>
    clock.now() >= entry.insertedAt + ttlMs;

  const cleanupExpired = (key: K): void => {
    const entry = entries.get(key);
    if (entry && isExpired(entry)) {
      entries.delete(key);
      const idx = accessOrder.indexOf(key);
      if (idx !== -1) accessOrder.splice(idx, 1);
    }
  };

  const evictLeastRecent = (): void => {
    while (true) {
      const headKey = accessOrder[0];
      if (headKey === undefined) break;
      const headEntry = entries.get(headKey);
      if (!headEntry || !isExpired(headEntry)) break;
      accessOrder.shift();
      entries.delete(headKey);
    }
    if (accessOrder.length >= capacity) {
      const evictedKey = accessOrder.shift();
      if (evictedKey !== undefined) entries.delete(evictedKey);
    }
  };

  const markRecent = (key: K): void => {
    const idx = accessOrder.indexOf(key);
    if (idx !== -1) accessOrder.splice(idx, 1);
    accessOrder.push(key);
  };

  return {
    get: (key: K): V | undefined => {
      const entry = entries.get(key);
      if (!entry || isExpired(entry)) {
        cleanupExpired(key);
        return undefined;
      }
      markRecent(key);
      return entry.value;
    },
    set: (key: K, value: V): void => {
      const existing = entries.get(key);
      if (existing) {
        existing.value = value;
        existing.insertedAt = clock.now();
        markRecent(key);
      } else {
        if (accessOrder.length >= capacity) evictLeastRecent();
        entries.set(key, { value, insertedAt: clock.now() });
        accessOrder.push(key);
      }
    },
    has: (key: K): boolean => {
      const entry = entries.get(key);
      if (!entry || isExpired(entry)) {
        cleanupExpired(key);
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    },
    get size(): number {
      return entries.size;
    },
  };
}
```

```typescript
  const entries = new Map<K, { value: V; insertedAt: number }>();
  const accessOrder: K[] = [];

  const isExpired = (entry: { insertedAt: number }): boolean =>
    clock.now() >= entry.insertedAt + ttlMs;

    const entry = entries.get(key);
    if (entry && isExpired(entry)) {
      entries.delete(key);
      const idx = accessOrder.indexOf(key);
      if (idx !== -1) accessOrder.splice(idx, 1);
    }
  };

  const evictLeastRecent = (): void => {
    while (true) {
      const headKey = accessOrder[0];
      if (headKey === undefined) break;
      const headEntry = entries.get(headKey);
      if (!headEntry || !isExpired(headEntry)) break;
      accessOrder.shift();
      entries.delete(headKey);
    }
    if (accessOrder.length >= capacity) {
      const evictedKey = accessOrder.shift();
      if (evictedKey !== undefined) entries.delete(evictedKey);
    }
  };

  const markRecent = (key: K): void => {
    const idx = accessOrder.indexOf(key);
    if (idx !== -1) accessOrder.splice(idx, 1);
    accessOrder.push(key);
  };

  return {
    get: (key: K): V | undefined => {
      const entry = entries.get(key);
      if (!entry || isExpired(entry)) {
        cleanupExpired(key);
        return undefined;
      }
      markRecent(key);
      return entry.value;
    },
    set: (key: K, value: V): void => {
      const existing = entries.get(key);
      if (existing) {
        existing.value = value;
        existing.insertedAt = clock.now();
        markRecent(key);
      } else {
        if (accessOrder.length >= capacity) evictLeastRecent();
        entries.set(key, { value, insertedAt: clock.now() });
        accessOrder.push(key);

        cleanupExpired(key);
        return false;

      let count = 0;

  };
```

type Token =
  | { readonly type: 'NUM'; readonly value: number }
  | { readonly type: 'PLUS' | 'MINUS' | 'MUL' | 'DIV' }
  | { readonly type: 'LPAREN' | 'RPAREN' | 'EOF' };

export type Result =
  | { readonly ok: true; readonly value: number }
  | { readonly ok: false; readonly error: string };

interface ParserState {
  readonly tokens: readonly Token[];
  pos: number;
}

function tokenize(input: string): Token[] | Result {
  const out: Token[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {
    const c = input[i];
    if (/\s/.test(c)) continue;
    if (/[0-9]/.test(c)) {
      let j = i; while (i < input.length && /[0-9]/.test(input[i])) i++;
      out.push({ type: 'NUM', value: Number(input.slice(j, i)) }); continue;
    }
    if (c === '+') out.push({ type: 'PLUS' });
    else if (c === '-') out.push({ type: 'MINUS' });
    else if (c === '*') out.push({ type: 'MUL' });
    else if (c === '/') out.push({ type: 'DIV' });
    else if (c === '(') out.push({ type: 'LPAREN' });
    else if (c === ')') out.push({ type: 'RPAREN' });
    else return { ok: false, error: `Unexpected char: ${c}` };
  }
  out.push({ type: 'EOF' });
  return out;
}

function parseExpr(state: ParserState): Result {
  let left = parseTerm(state);
  while (true) {
    const token = state.tokens[state.pos];
    if (token?.type !== 'PLUS' && token?.type !== 'MINUS') break;
    state.pos++;
    const right = parseTerm(state);
    if (!right.ok) return right;
    left = token.type === 'PLUS' ? { ok: true, value: left.value + right.value } : { ok: true, value: left.value - right.value };
  }
  return left;
}

function parseTerm(state: ParserState): Result {
  let left = parseFactor(state);
  while (true) {
    const token = state.tokens[state.pos];
    if (token?.type !== 'MUL' && token?.type !== 'DIV') break;
    state.pos++;
    const right = parseFactor(state);
    if (!right.ok) return right;
    if (token.type === 'DIV' && right.value === 0) return { ok: false, error: 'Division by zero' };
    left = token.type === 'MUL' ? { ok: true, value: left.value * right.value } : { ok: true, value: left.value / right.value };
  }
  return left;
}

function parseFactor(state: ParserState): Result {
  const token = state.tokens[state.pos];
  if (!token || token.type === 'EOF') return { ok: false, error: 'Missing operand' };
  if (token.type === 'NUM') {
    state.pos++;
    return { ok: true, value: token.value };
  }
  if (token.type === 'LPAREN') {
    state.pos++;
    const res = parseExpr(state);
    if (!res.ok) return res;
    const close = state.tokens[state.pos];
    if (!close || close.type !== 'RPAREN') return { ok: false, error: 'Missing closing parenthesis' };
    state.pos++;
    return res;
  }
  return { ok: false, error: `Unexpected token: ${token.type}` };
}

export function evaluate(expr: string): Result {
  const tokensOrErr = tokenize(expr);
  if (!tokensOrErr.ok) return tokensOrErr;
  const state: ParserState = { tokens: tokensOrErr, pos: 0 };
  const res = parseExpr(state);
  if (!res.ok) return res;
  if (state.tokens[state.pos].type !== 'EOF') return { ok: false, error: 'Unexpected trailing characters' };
  return res;
}

```ts
export type Amount =
  | { readonly kind: "fixed"; readonly value: number }
  | { readonly kind: "percent"; readonly pct: number }
```

// FILE: pricing.ts
import type { Amount, LineItem } from "./types";

export const PERCENT_BASE = 100;

    ```ts
function computeSyncAdjustment(base: number, amount: Amount): number {
  if (amount.kind === "fixed") return amount.value;
  if (amount.kind === "percent") return (base * amount.pct) / PERCENT_BASE;
  return 0;
}

export async function lineTotal(item: LineItem): Promise<number> {
  let adjustment: number;
  if (item.adjustment.kind === "deferred") {
    adjustment = await item.adjustment.load();
  } else {
    adjustment = computeSyncAdjustment(item.base, item.adjustment);
  }
  return item.base + adjustment;
}

export async function computeTotal(items: readonly LineItem[]): Promise<number> {
    ```
    ```ts
  const totals = await Promise.all(items.map(lineTotal));
  return totals.reduce((sum: number, t: number): number => sum + t, 0);
}
    ```

    ```ts
import type { Amount, LineItem } from "./types";
import { lineTotal } from "./pricing";

const KIND_LABEL: Readonly<Record<Amount["kind"], string>> = {
  fixed: "flat",
  percent: "rate",
  deferred: "deferred",
};
const UNKNOWN_LABEL = "other";

export function amountLabel(amount: Amount): string {
  return KIND_LABEL[amount.kind] ?? UNKNOWN_LABEL;
}

export async function reportLine(item: LineItem): Promise<string> {
  const total = await lineTotal(item);
  return `${item.id} [${amountLabel(item.adjustment)}]: ${String(total)}`;
}

export async function buildReport(items: readonly LineItem[]): Promise<readonly string[]> {
  const lines = await Promise.all(items.map(reportLine));
  return lines;
}
    ```

import type { Clock } from "../../lib/clock";

export interface PriceCache {
  get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number>;
}

interface CacheEntry {
  readonly value: number;
  readonly expiresAt: number;
}

const DEFAULT_TTL_MS = 60_000;

export function createPriceCache(clock: Clock, ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS): PriceCache {
  const entries = new Map<string, CacheEntry>();
  const inFlight = new Map<string, Promise<number>>();

  return {
    async get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number> {
      const now = clock.now();
      const cached = entries.get(key);
      if (cached !== undefined && cached.expiresAt > now) return cached.value;
      const flight = inFlight.get(key);
      if (flight !== undefined) {
        try {
          const v = await flight;
          if (!entries.has(key)) entries.set(key, { value: v, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
          return v;
        } catch { inFlight.delete(key); throw; }
      }
      const p = compute();
      inFlight.set(key, p);
      try {
        const v = await p;
        entries.set(key, { value: v, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
        return v;
      } catch { inFlight.delete(key); throw; }
    },
  };
}

// FILE: pricing.ts
import type { Amount, LineItem } from "./types";

export const PERCENT_BASE = 100;

function pctOf(amount: Amount): number {
  return amount.kind === "percent" ? amount.pct : 0;
}

async function adjustmentValue(base: number, amount: Amount): Promise<number> {
  if (amount.kind === "fixed") {
    return amount.value;
  }
  if (amount.kind === "percent") {
    return (base * pctOf(amount)) / PERCENT_BASE;
  }
  return amount.load();
}

export async function lineTotal(item: LineItem): Promise<number> {
  return item.base + await adjustmentValue(item.base, item.adjustment);
}

export async function computeTotal(items: readonly LineItem[]): Promise<number> {
  let sum = 0;
  for (const item of items) {
    sum += await lineTotal(item);
  }
  return sum;
}

import type { Amount, LineItem } from "./types";
import { lineTotal } from "./pricing";

const KIND_LABEL: Partial<Record<Amount["kind"], string>> = {
  fixed: "flat",
  percent: "rate",
  deferred: "deferred",
};
const UNKNOWN_LABEL = "other";

export function amountLabel(amount: Amount): string {
  return KIND_LABEL[amount.kind] ?? UNKNOWN_LABEL;
}

export async function reportLine(item: LineItem): Promise<string> {
  const total = await lineTotal(item);
  return `${item.id} [${amountLabel(item.adjustment)}]: ${String(total)}`;
}

export async function buildReport(items: readonly LineItem[]): Promise<readonly string[]> {
  return Promise.all(items.map((item: LineItem): Promise<string> => reportLine(item)));
}

import type { Clock } from "../../lib/clock";

export interface PriceCache {
  get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number>;
}

interface CacheEntry {
  readonly promise: Promise<number>;
  readonly expiresAt: number;
}

const DEFAULT_TTL_MS = 60_000;

export function createPriceCache(clock: Clock, ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS): PriceCache {
  const entries = new Map<string, CacheEntry>();

  return {
    async get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number> {
      const now = clock.now();
      const existing = entries.get(key);
      if (existing !== undefined && existing.expiresAt > now) {
        return existing.promise;
      }

      const expiresAt = now + ttlMs;
      const promise = compute().then(
        (value) => {
          entries.set(key, { promise, expiresAt });
          return value;
        },
        () => {
          entries.delete(key);
          throw new Error("Compute failed");
        }
      );

      entries.set(key, { promise, expiresAt });
      return promise;
    },
  };
}

   ```ts
interface Entry<V> { value: V; expiresAt: number; }

export function createLruCache<K, V>(capacity: number, ttlMs: number, clock: Clock): LruCache<K, V> {
  const store = new Map<K, Entry<V>>();

  const isLive = (entry: Entry<V>): boolean => clock.now() < entry.expiresAt;

  const removeExpired = (key: K): void => {
    const entry = store.get(key);
    if (entry && !isLive(entry)) store.delete(key);
  };

  const touchRecency = (key: K): void => {
    const entry = store.get(key);
    if (entry && isLive(entry)) {
      store.delete(key);
      store.set(key, entry);
    }
  };

  const evictLru = (): void => {
    for (const [key] of store) {
   ```
     ```ts
      const current = store.get(key);
      if (current && isLive(current)) {
        store.delete(key);
        break;
      }
    }
  };
     ```

   ```ts
  const countLive = (): number => {
    let count = 0;
    for (const entry of store.values()) if (isLive(entry)) count++;
    return count;
  };

  return {
    get(key: K): V | undefined {
      removeExpired(key);
      const entry = store.get(key);
      if (entry) { touchRecency(key); return entry.value; }
      return undefined;
    },
    set(key: K, value: V): void {
      removeExpired(key);
      while (!isLive(store.get(key)) && countLive() >= capacity) evictLru();
      store.set(key, { value, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
    },
    has(key: K): boolean {
      removeExpired(key);
      return store.has(key);
    },
    get size(): number {
      let count = 0;
      for (const entry of store.values()) if (isLive(entry)) count++;
      return count;
    }
  };
}

export interface LruCache<K, V> {
  get(key: K): V | undefined;
  set(key: K, value: V): void;
  has(key: K): boolean;
  readonly size: number;
   ```

```ts
import { Clock, systemClock } from '../lib/clock';

const DEFAULT_TOKENS = 1 as const;

export interface RateLimiter {
  readonly tryAcquire: (key: string, tokens?: number) => boolean;
}

export function createRateLimiter(
  capacity: number,
  refillPerSec: number,
  clock: Clock = systemClock
): RateLimiter {
  const buckets = new Map<string, { lastRefillTime: number; tokens: number }>();

  function refillBucket(entry: { lastRefillTime: number; tokens: number }): void {
    const now = clock.now();
    const elapsedSeconds = (now - entry.lastRefillTime) / 1000;
    const newTokens = elapsedSeconds * refillPerSec;
    if (newTokens > 0) {
      entry.tokens = Math.min(capacity, entry.tokens + newTokens);
      entry.lastRefillTime = now;
    }
  }

  function tryAcquire(key: string, tokens: number = DEFAULT_TOKENS): boolean {
    let entry = buckets.get(key);
    if (!entry) {
      const now = clock.now();
      buckets.set(key, { lastRefillTime: now, tokens: capacity });
      return true;
    }

    refillBucket(entry);
    if (entry.tokens >= tokens) {
      entry.tokens -= tokens;
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  return { tryAcquire };
}
```

export type Result =
  | { readonly ok: true; readonly value: number }
  | { readonly ok: false; readonly error: string };

interface Token { readonly type: 'num'; readonly value: number }
            | { readonly type: 'op'; readonly value: string }
            | { readonly type: 'end' };

interface Parser { readonly tokens: readonly Token[]; pos: number; }

const tokenize = (input: string): readonly Token[] | Result => {
  const tokens: Token[] = [];
  let i = 0;
  while (i < input.length) {
    if (/\s/.test(input[i])) { i++; continue; }
    if (/[\d]/.test(input[i])) {
      let num = '';
      while (i < input.length && /[\d]/.test(input[i])) { num += input[i++]; }
      tokens.push({ type: 'num', value: Number(num) });
    } else if (['+', '-', '*', '/'].includes(input[i])) {
      tokens.push({ type: 'op', value: input[i] }); i++;
    } else {
      return { ok: false, error: `Unexpected character` };
    }
  }
  tokens.push({ type: 'end' });
  return tokens;
};

const evaluate = (expr: string): Result => {
  const tokens = tokenize(expr);
  if ('error' in tokens) return tokens;
  const parser = { tokens, pos: 0 };
  const result = exprParser(parser);
  if (!result.ok || parser.tokens[parser.pos]?.type !== 'end') {
    return result.ok ? { ok: false, error: 'Unexpected trailing token' } : result;
  }
  return result;
};

const exprParser = (p: Parser): Result => {
  let left = termParser(p);
  while ('ok' in left && p.tokens[p.pos]?.type === 'op') {
    const op = p.tokens[p.pos].value;
    if (op !== '+' && op !== '-') break;
    p.pos++;
    const right = termParser(p);
    if (!right.ok) return right;
    if (op === '+') left = { ok: true, value: left.value + right.value };
    else left = { ok: true, value: left.value - right.value };
  }
  return left;
};

const termParser = (p: Parser): Result => {
  let left = factorParser(p);
  while ('ok' in left && p.tokens[p.pos]?.type === 'op') {
    const op = p.tokens[p.pos].value;
    if (op !== '*' && op !== '/') break;
    p.pos++;
    const right = factorParser(p);
    if (!right.ok) return right;
    if (op === '*') left = { ok: true, value: left.value * right.value };
    else {
      if (right.value === 0) return { ok: false, error: 'Division by zero' };
      left = { ok: true, value: left.value / right.value };
    }
  }
  return left;
};

const factorParser = (p: Parser): Result => {
  if (!p.tokens[p.pos]) return { ok: false, error: 'Unexpected end' };
  const t = p.tokens[p.pos];
  if (t.type === 'num') { p.pos++; return { ok: true, value: t.value }; }
  if (t.type === 'op' && t.value === '(') {
    p.pos++;
    const inner = exprParser(p);
    if (!inner.ok || p.tokens[p.pos]?.type !== 'op' || p.tokens[p.pos].value !== ')') {
      return { ok: false, error: 'Missing closing parenthesis' };
    }
    p.pos++;
    return inner;
  }
  if (t.type === 'end') return { ok: false, error: 'Expected value' };
  return { ok: false, error: 'Unexpected token' };
};

```typescript
export interface PriceCache {
  get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number>;
}

interface CacheEntry {
  readonly value: number;
  readonly expiresAt: number;
}

const DEFAULT_TTL_MS = 60_000;

export function createPriceCache(clock: Clock, ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS): PriceCache {
  const entries = new Map<string, CacheEntry>();
```
```typescript
  const pending = new Map<string, Promise<number>>();

  return {
    async get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number> {
      const hit = entries.get(key);
      if (hit !== undefined && hit.expiresAt > clock.now()) {

      if (existingPending !== undefined) {

          const value = await compute();
          entries.set(key, { value, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });

      })();

      pending.set(key, computePromise);
      return computePromise;
    },
  };
```

```typescript
import type { Amount, LineItem } from "./types";

export const PERCENT_BASE = 100;

function pctOf(amount: Amount): number {
  return amount.kind === "percent" ? amount.pct : 0;
}

function syncAdjustment(base: number, amount: Amount): number {
  switch (amount.kind) {
    case "fixed":
      return amount.value;
    case "percent":
      return (base * pctOf(amount)) / PERCENT_BASE;
    case "deferred":
      return 0;
  }
}

export async function lineTotal(item: LineItem): Promise<number> {
  let adjustment = syncAdjustment(item.base, item.adjustment);
  if (item.adjustment.kind === "deferred") {
    adjustment = await item.adjustment.load();
  }
  return item.base + adjustment;
}

export async function computeTotal(items: readonly LineItem[]): Promise<number> {
  let sum = 0;
  for (const item of items) {
    sum += await lineTotal(item);
  }
  return sum;
}
```

```typescript
import type { Clock } from "../../lib/clock";

export interface PriceCache {
  get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number>;
}

interface CacheEntry {
  readonly value: number;
  readonly expiresAt: number;
}

const DEFAULT_TTL_MS = 60_000;

export function createPriceCache(clock: Clock, ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS): PriceCache {
  const entries = new Map<string, CacheEntry>();
  const pending = new Map<string, Promise<number>>();

  return {
    async get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number> {
      const hit = entries.get(key);
      if (hit !== undefined && hit.expiresAt > clock.now()) {
        return hit.value;
      }

      const existingPending = pending.get(key);
      if (existingPending !== undefined) {
        return existingPending;
      }

      const computePromise = (async (): Promise<number> => {
        try {
          const value = await compute();
          entries.set(key, { value, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
          return value;
        } finally {
          pending.delete(key);
        }
      })();

      pending.set(key, computePromise);
      return computePromise;
    },
  };
}
```

```typescript
export interface PriceCache {
  get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number>;

interface CacheEntry {
  readonly value: number;
  readonly expiresAt: number;

export function createPriceCache(clock: Clock, ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS): PriceCache {
  const entries = new Map<string, CacheEntry>();
  const pending = new Map<string, Promise<number>>();

  return {
```

   ```ts
        promise = (async () => {
          try {
            const value = await compute();
            entries.set(key, { value, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
            return value;
          } finally {

          }
        })();
        pending.set(key, promise);
   ```

   ```ts
  | { readonly kind: "fixed"; readonly value: number }
  | { readonly kind: "percent"; readonly pct: number }
   ```

// FILE: pricing.ts
import type { Amount, LineItem } from "./types";

export const PERCENT_BASE = 100;

function pctOf(amount: Amount): number {
  return amount.kind === "percent" ? amount.pct : 0;
}

function resolveAdjustment(base: number, amount: Amount): Promise<number> {
  if (amount.kind === "fixed") return Promise.resolve(amount.value);
  if (amount.kind === "percent") return Promise.resolve((base * pctOf(amount)) / PERCENT_BASE);
  return amount.load();
}

export async function lineTotal(item: LineItem): Promise<number> {
  const adjustment = await resolveAdjustment(item.base, item.adjustment);
  return item.base + adjustment;
}

export async function computeTotal(items: readonly LineItem[]): Promise<number> {
  let total = 0;
  for (const item of items) {
    total += await lineTotal(item);
  }
  return total;
}

// FILE: report.ts
import type { Amount, LineItem } from "./types";
import { lineTotal } from "./pricing";

const KIND_LABEL: Record<Amount["kind"], string> = {
  fixed: "flat",
  percent: "rate",
  deferred: "deferred",
};

export function amountLabel(amount: Amount): string {
  return KIND_LABEL[amount.kind];
}

export async function reportLine(item: LineItem): Promise<string> {
  const total = await lineTotal(item);
  return `${item.id} [${amountLabel(item.adjustment)}]: ${total}`;
}

export async function buildReport(items: readonly LineItem[]): Promise<readonly string[]> {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  for (const item of items) {
    lines.push(await reportLine(item));
  }
  return lines as readonly string[];
}

import type { Clock } from "../../lib/clock";

export interface PriceCache {
  get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number>;
}

interface CacheEntry {
  readonly value: number;
  readonly expiresAt: number;
}

const DEFAULT_TTL_MS = 60_000;

export function createPriceCache(clock: Clock, ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS): PriceCache {
  const entries = new Map<string, CacheEntry>();
  const pendingComputations = new Map<string, Promise<number>>();

  return {
    async get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number> {
      const hit = entries.get(key);
      if (hit !== undefined && hit.expiresAt > clock.now()) {
        return hit.value;
      }

      const existingPending = pendingComputations.get(key);
      if (existingPending !== undefined) {
        return existingPending;
      }

      const computationPromise = compute().then(
        value => {
          entries.set(key, { value, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
          pendingComputations.delete(key);
          return value;
        },
        error => {
          pendingComputations.delete(key);
          throw error;
        }
      );

      pendingComputations.set(key, computationPromise);
      return computationPromise;
    },
  };
}

import type { Clock } from '../../lib/clock';

export interface LruCache<K, V> {
  get(key: K): V | undefined;
  set(key: K, value: V): void;
  has(key: K): boolean;
  readonly size: number;
}

type CacheEntry<V> = {
  readonly createdAt: number;
  lastAccessedAt: number;
  value: V;
};

const isExpired = (createdAt: number, ttlMs: number, now: number): boolean =>
  now >= createdAt + ttlMs;

const findLeastRecentKey = <K extends string | number | symbol, V>(map: Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>): K | undefined => {
  let minKey: K | undefined;
  let minTs: number = Infinity;
  for (const [key, entry] of map.entries()) {
    if (entry.lastAccessedAt < minTs) {
      minTs = entry.lastAccessedAt;
      minKey = key;
    }
  }
  return minKey;
};

export function createLruCache<K, V>(capacity: number, ttlMs: number, clock: Clock): LruCache<K, V> {
  const store = new Map<K, CacheEntry<V>>();

  const countLive = (): number => {
    let total = 0;
    for (const entry of store.values()) {
      if (!isExpired(entry.createdAt, ttlMs, clock.now())) total++;
    }
    return total;
  };

  const evictOne = (): void => {
    const key = findLeastRecentKey(store);
    if (key !== undefined) store.delete(key);
  };

  const cleanupExpired = (): void => {
    for (const key of [...store.keys()]) {
      const entry = store.get(key);
      if (entry !== undefined && isExpired(entry.createdAt, ttlMs, clock.now())) {
        store.delete(key);
      }
    }
  };

  return {
    get: (key: K): V | undefined => {
      cleanupExpired();
      const entry = store.get(key);
      if (entry === undefined) return undefined;
      store.set(key, { ...entry, lastAccessedAt: clock.now() });
      return entry.value;
    },

    set: (key: K, value: V): void => {
      const now = clock.now();
      const existing = store.get(key);
      store.set(key, {
        createdAt: existing?.createdAt ?? now,
        lastAccessedAt: now,
        value
      });

      while (countLive() > capacity) evictOne();
    },

    has: (key: K): boolean => {
      const entry = store.get(key);
      if (entry === undefined) return false;
      return !isExpired(entry.createdAt, ttlMs, clock.now());
    },

    get size(): number {
      cleanupExpired();
      return store.size;
    }
  };
}

import type { Clock } from '../../lib/clock';

export interface LruCache<K, V> {
  get(key: K): V | undefined;
  set(key: K, value: V): void;
  has(key: K): boolean;
  readonly size: number;
}

interface Entry<V> {
  readonly value: V;
  readonly expiresAt: number;
}

export function createLruCache<K, V>(
  capacity: number,
  ttlMs: number,
  clock: Clock
): LruCache<K, V> {
  const map = new Map<K, Entry<V>>();

  const isExpired = (e: Entry<V>): boolean => clock.now() >= e.expiresAt;

  const cleanExpiredFromFront = (): void => {
    for (const key of map.keys()) {
      const entry = map.get(key);
      if (entry && isExpired(entry)) map.delete(key);
      else return;
    }
  };

  const evictLiveOldest = (): void => {
    for (const key of map.keys()) {
      const entry = map.get(key);
      if (entry && !isExpired(entry)) return void map.delete(key);
    }
  };

  const touchRecency = (key: K): void => {
    const e = map.get(key);
    if (e) map.delete(key);
    if (e) map.set(key, e);
  };

  return {
    get: (key: K): V | undefined => {
      const entry = map.get(key);
      if (entry == null || isExpired(entry)) return undefined;
      touchRecency(key);
      return entry.value;
    },

    set: (key: K, value: V): void => {
      cleanExpiredFromFront();
      if (!map.has(key) && map.size >= capacity) evictLiveOldest();
      if (map.has(key)) map.delete(key);
      map.set(key, { value, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
    },

    has: (key: K): boolean => {
      const entry = map.get(key);
      return entry != null && !isExpired(entry);
    },

    get size(): number {
      let count = 0;
      for (const [, e] of map) if (!isExpired(e)) count++;
      return count;
    },
  };
}

   ```typescript
// FILE: impl.ts
import type { Clock } from '../../lib/clock';

interface BucketState {
  tokens: number;
   ```
```ts
  lastRefillTime: number;
}
```

```ts
const DEFAULT_ACQUIRE_TOKENS = 1;

function refillBucket(
  state: BucketState,
  now: number,
  capacity: number,
  ratePerSecond: number
): void {
  const elapsedSeconds = now - state.lastRefillTime;
  if (elapsedSeconds <= 0) return;
  state.tokens += elapsedSeconds * ratePerSecond;
  if (state.tokens > capacity) {
    state.tokens = capacity;
  }
}

export interface RateLimiter {
  tryAcquire(key: string, tokens?: number): boolean;
}

export function createRateLimiter(
  capacity: number,
  refillPerSec: number,
  clock: Clock
): RateLimiter {
  const buckets = new Map<string, BucketState>();

  return {
    tryAcquire(key: string, requested?: number): boolean {
      const amount = requested ?? DEFAULT_ACQUIRE_TOKENS;
      const now = clock.now();

      let bucket = buckets.get(key);
      if (bucket === undefined) {
        bucket = { tokens: capacity, lastRefillTime: now };
        buckets.set(key, bucket);
      } else {
        refillBucket(bucket, now, capacity, refillPerSec);
      }

      if (bucket.tokens >= amount) {
        bucket.tokens -= amount;
        bucket.lastRefillTime = now;
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    }
  };
}
```

  return amount.kind === "percent" ? amount.pct : 0;

import type { Clock } from "../../lib/clock";

export interface PriceCache {
  /** Return the cached total for `key` if fresh, else run `compute` and cache its result. */
  get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number>;
}

interface CacheEntry {
  readonly value: number;
  readonly expiresAt: number;
}

const DEFAULT_TTL_MS = 60_000;

export function createPriceCache(clock: Clock, ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS): PriceCache {
  const entries = new Map<string, CacheEntry>();
  const pendingComputations = new Map<string, Promise<number>>();

  return {
    async get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number> {
      const hit = entries.get(key);
      if (hit !== undefined && hit.expiresAt > clock.now()) {
        return hit.value;
      }

      let pendingPromise = pendingComputations.get(key);
      if (pendingPromise) {
        return await pendingPromise;
      }

      const chain = async (): Promise<number> => {
        try {
          const value = await compute();
          entries.set(key, { value, expiresAt: clock.now() + ttlMs });
          return value;
        } catch (err) {
          entries.delete(key);
          throw err;
        } finally {
          pendingComputations.delete(key);
        }
      };

      pendingPromise = chain();
      pendingComputations.set(key, pendingPromise);
      return pendingPromise;
    },
  };
}

// FILE: pricing.ts
import type { Amount, LineItem } from "./types";

export const PERCENT_BASE = 100;

function pctOf(amount: Amount): number {
  return amount.kind === "percent" ? amount.pct : 0;
}

async function adjustmentOf(base: number, amount: Amount): Promise<number> {
  switch (amount.kind) {
    case "fixed": return amount.value;
    case "percent": return (base * pctOf(amount)) / PERCENT_BASE;
    default: return amount.load();
  }
}

export async function lineTotal(item: LineItem): Promise<number> {
  const adjustment = await adjustmentOf(item.base, item.adjustment);
  return item.base + adjustment;
}

export async function computeTotal(items: readonly LineItem[]): Promise<number> {
  const totals = await Promise.all(items.map(lineTotal));
  return totals.reduce((sum: number, total: number): number => sum + total, 0);
}

import type { Amount, LineItem } from "./types";
import { lineTotal } from "./pricing";

const KIND_LABEL: Record<Amount["kind"], string> = {
  fixed: "flat",
  percent: "rate",
  deferred: "deferred",
};

const UNKNOWN_LABEL = "other";

export function amountLabel(amount: Amount): string {
  return KIND_LABEL[amount.kind] ?? UNKNOWN_LABEL;
}

export async function reportLine(item: LineItem): Promise<string> {
  const total = await lineTotal(item);
  return `${item.id} [${amountLabel(item.adjustment)}]: ${String(total)}`;
}

export async function buildReport(items: readonly LineItem[]): Promise<readonly string[]> {
  return Promise.all(items.map(reportLine));
}

    const p3 = cache.get("k", compute);
    await expect(p3).rejects.toThrow();
    expect(await p3.catch(() => "p3-failed")).toBe("p3-failed");
    expect(failInvocation).toBe(2);
  });

  it("should keep different keys completely independent", async () => {
    let k1Calls = 0;
    let k2Calls = 0;
    const cache = createPriceCache({ now: (): number => 0 }, 60_000);

    await Promise.all([
      cache.get("k1", async () => { k1Calls += 1; return 1; }),
      cache.get("k2", async () => { k2Calls += 1; return 2; }),
    ]);
    expect(k1Calls).toBe(1);
    expect(k2Calls).toBe(1);

    const val1 = await cache.get("k1", async () => { k1Calls += 1; return 99; });
    expect(val1).toBe(1);
    expect(k1Calls).toBe(1);
  });
});
